name: lyf Chinatown Singapore
tagline: Heritage-Led Extended Stays Experiences
description:
Located in the heart of one of Singapore’s iconic cultural districts, lyf Chinatown Singapore brings the neighbourhood’s old-world charm and colours to life. This 90-room serviced residence blends heritage and modern living for travellers who love being where the action is.

 

Step outside and find yourself surrounded by heritage shophouses, traditional teahouses, hawker centres, and street art. Take a stroll through Pagoda Street, explore the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, or catch the evening buzz at Ann Siang Hill and Club Street, all within minutes from your doorstep.

 

Getting around is a breeze with Chinatown MRT (DT19/NE4) and Maxwell Station (TE18) just a short walk away, connecting you easily to the Central Business District, Bugis, and Orchard Road.

 

Spark new connections, rediscover the city from a fresh perspective, and live your best lyf right here in lyf Chinatown Singapore!

Location
Right in the heart of Singapore’s iconic cultural district, lyf Chinatown Singapore puts you at the centre of culture, food, and fun. From hawker favourites to street art, everything you need is right at your doorstep! Take a stroll down Pagoda Street, Mosque Street, explore the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, or explore interactive cultural exhibits at Chinatown Heritage Centre.

 

Getting around is just as easy! The Chinatown MRT Station is less than a 5-minute walk away, while Maxwell MRT Station and Outram Park MRT Station are also nearby, giving you seamless access to the Central Business District, Marina Bay, Bugis, and Orchard Road in under 15 minutes.

 

Our address:

25 Mosque Street#01-01
Jamae Chulia Heritage

Singapore 059937

Apartments
Designed for the nomad seeking experience-led social living in Singapore. Our apartments come fully furnished with comfy beds, ensuite bathrooms, kitchenettes, and complimentary high speed Wi-Fi. Find your perfect fit within our various apartment types, whether you're travelling solo, as a couple or a group!

*Room layouts may vary due to the building's conserved heritage architecture.

Official room cards
Nano Single — 15 sqm.
A cosy, themed space designed for solo travellers who value privacy with a touch of personality. The Nano Single offers a comfortable retreat to relax and recharge, as you unwind and settle in after a day out. 

Rooms are windowless

Nano Twin — 15 sqm.
Perfect for friends or travel companions, the Nano Twin offers a seamless blend of comfort and practicality. Featuring twin beds, it is ideal for BFFs or sleep kickers, so everyone gets their own space to rest easy. After a day out, unwind in your cosy retreat, then head to the shared kitchenette for a quick bite or a casual chat with fellow travellers.

-Shared Kitchenette

Nano Queen — 11 sqm.
A cosy studio designed for travellers who want privacy yet enjoy being part of a social community, complete with a shared kitchenette. The Nano Queen is the perfect balance between personal downtime and social moments. Unwind in your private nook, or head over to the the shared kitchenette area to whip up a quick meal, connect and trade stories with fellow travellers.

-Shared Kitchenette
*Room layouts may vary due to the building's conserved heritage architecture.

Nano Queen Plus — 14 sqm.
Whether it’s winding down after spending the day soaking in the sights of the city or catching up on work and thinking up your next big idea, our Nano Queen Plus is perfectly designed with everything you need!

 

-In-room Kitchenette

Level Up — 12 sqm.
Perfect for families, friends, or small groups looking for a shared space that feels like home. Unwind on a cosy queen bed, stay productive at your work desk, or whip up a meal in the shared kitchenette in our Level Up. Side by Side — 20 sqm.
Ideal for friends or travel companions, the Side-by-Side features twin beds that let each guest enjoy their own space while staying together. Thoughtfully designed for two, it’s the perfect setup to unwind, stream your favourite shows or recharge in your own comfortable bed.

 

- In-room Kitchenette

One of A Kind — 19 sqm.
A perfect oasis for the couple who likes to snuggle or for the individual who enjoys a quiet space, the One of a Kind studio has all you need to live comfortably, play creatively, and work efficiently.

Our One of A Kind offers all the comfort with more room to live your best lyf. Whether you’re unwinding after a day in Chinatown or powering through a work session, this room type gives you the best of both comfort and creativity.

-In-room Kitchenette

One of A Kind Plus — 41 sqm.
Perfect for travellers who value space, flexibility, and a little extra comfort for work or downtime. Spacious, stylish, and designed for modern living, our One of a Kind Plus gives you room to stretch, create, and unwind. This suite is your personal haven to live and play the lyf way.

-In-room Kitchenette 

-Lounge Area

All about that ‘one of a kind’ situation, but upsized and served up alongside a shared kitchenette. Our Two of a Kind offers 2 bedroom accommodation – perfect for four people, or just two if you prefer not to share. 

For those looking for a two-bedroom apartment, our Two of a Kind gives you the best of both worlds, with your own space and a room to connect. Made for four, or just two if you like a little extra space to yourselves, you’ve got everything you need to unwind and live your best lyf together. Staying a little longer? We say, go for it.

Perfect for families, friends, or small groups looking for a shared space that feels like home.

Facilities
lyf’s got you covered with all the amenities you need to live, work and play! From connecting with fellow travellers to getting things done or simply unwinding, our social spaces are designed for connection, creativity, and everything in between, so you can make the most of your stay.

Official named facilities
SAY HI
Your adventure starts here! Come chat with our friendly lyf guards while you check in with our mobile app. Need recommendations, local tips, or a quick assist? This is your go-to spot to connect, explore, and get the most out of your stay.

CONNECT: CO-WORKING LOUNGE
Hangout with other guests here at Connect, our communal lounge that also doubles as a coworking space. It's the perfect spot to bang out some work or to wind down after hours!

BOND: SOCIAL KITCHEN
The kitchen is the heart of the home – cook up a storm in our fully equipped social kitchen. Whip up your favourite dishes, swap recipes with fellow travellers, and bond over good food and great company.

WASH&HANG: LAUNDERETTE
Let our washers do the work while you kick back. Pop your laundry in, grab a book, and enjoy some downtime at The Outdoors.

BURN: SOCIAL GYM
Turn up the energy at BURN! Whether you're powering through a workout or just getting started, we've got everything you need to break a sweat.

DIP: SWIMMING POOL
Soak up the sun at our rooftop pool, stretch out on the pool deck, or just float your worries away.

OUTDOOR COURTYARD
Take the fun outside at our outdoor courtyard, made for chill hangs and spontaneous meet-ups. Grab a coffee, strike up a convo, or kick back under the open sky with a whole lot of chill.

COLLAB
Where big ideas come to lyf. Gather and brainstorm in our purposefully designed meeting room built to keep creativity flowing!

*Booking required. Only available for Paid Use.

Attic
Unwind your way. Kick back with a coffee, catch up on work, or simply enjoy the moment in this flexible shared space near DIP.

Official preOpeningSummary
Strategically located within the Jamae Chulia Heritage site in the heart of Chinatown, the 90-unit property will be the first lyf in Singapore to be housed in a newly developed building alongside four pre-war conservation shophouses at Pagoda Street. Exemplifying the lyf brand’s stay, work and play concept, future guests can look forward to tastefully designed apartment units with shared social spaces and a curation of experiential programmes that leverage the vibrancy of the community, with a focus on arts and culture. lyf Chinatown Singapore is expected to open in mid-2026.

name: lyf Farrer Park Singapore
tagline: Experience Led Extended Stay Apartments
description:
Located right in the middle of Farrer Park, lyf Farrer Park Singapore is just a stone’s throw away from Little India, a unique and vibrant neighbourhood in Singapore. Immerse in the cultural hub's neverending rows of shops, selling unique knick-knacks or eclectic cuisine. To maximise your local experience, level up your 'fit with a custom-made outfit from a tailor or a beautiful henna tattoo from a local artist and snap a pic against the locale's colourful architecture!

 

Get comfortable after a long day in our new and fully furnished apartments with ensuite bathrooms and high speed Wi-Fi. Our different apartment types cater to a range of group sizes and social preferences. So whether you are travelling with friends, family or just going solo, you are sure to find an ideal setup to suit all your needs.

 

Be part of an exciting community and network with like-minded individuals at one of lyf’s various social spaces! Join our community events and you may find your next collaborator in one of our networking sessions, learn about a new cuisine in BOND (our fully equipped social kitchen), or meet a new workout buddy at our HIIT classes in BURN, social gym. There is always something going on in our functional social spaces! 

 

Getting around from lyf Farrer Park Singapore is easy with its central and accessible location. With a 2 min walk to the MRT, you are just a few stops away from the Orchard shopping district and the Central Business District. With such good connectivity, you never have to worry about long travel times dragging you down! 

 

The possibilities are endless when staying at lyf! Whether you are just stopping by in town or looking for a long stay apartments in Singapore, this property has everything you need to live your best lyf!

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
lyf Farrer Park Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 8.86 kg CO2e per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore. 
Water Footprint: 244.27 litres per room night - amongst top-performing peers in Singapore.

Location
lyf Farrer Park Singapore is perfect for those who are seeking an accessible location - With a variety of amenities all within a 5 minute radius and the ease of hopping onto a train to the city or go shopping for groceries in City Square Mall all within a 2-5 minutes journey. Fancy some sightseeing? Take a short walk to the heart of Little India and explore the sights and sounds of one of Singapore’s rare historic and colourful ethnic enclaves.

 

Getting to lyf Farrer Park Singapore is easy and convenient with its central location and proximity to public transport. It is a short 20 minute drive by car from Singapore Changi Airport and only 10 minutes to the Central Business District. It is also just a 2 minute walk away from Farrer Park MRT which puts you 3 stops away from the Orchard Road shopping district and the 4 stops from the Central Business District. With this exceptional location, you can spend less time travelling and more time doing the things you love! All in all, if you are looking for a shared apartment in Singapore, our establishment offers you a wide array abodes conveniently located within minutes reach to the city's popular attractions. 

 

Our address:

2 Perumal Road, #01-01

Nearest MRT: Purple Line – Farrer Park MRT

Bus: 130, 147, 23, 65

Apartments
Designed for the nomad seeking the coliving experience, our shared apartments in Singapore come fully furnished with comfy beds, ensuite bathrooms and complimentary high speed Wi-Fi. Find your perfect fit within our various apartment types, whether you're travelling solo, as a couple or a group!

Official room cards
One of A Kind (Studio) — 15 sqm.
Whether it’s winding down after spending the day soaking in the sights of the city or catching up on work and thinking up your next big idea, our One of a Kind co living Singapore studio unit is perfectly designed with everything you need!

Side by Side (Studio Twin) — 15 sqm.
Looking for a short term rental stay in Singapore? Our studio twin is perfect for two. Have a blast with a movie marathon or get productive with our functional work desk. The apartment is equipped with the essentials to switch it up anytime!

Two of A Kind (2 Bedroom) — 39 sqm.
All the essentials are within reach! Kick back and relax on the spacious queen bed, cook up a simple meal in the pantry or get up to speed with work at the functional work desk during your stay in this cosy two bedroom apartment in Singapore!

Facilities
lyf’s got you covered with all the amenities you need to live, work and play! Need to jump on a call or bring in new collaborators? Just book one of our flexible meeting rooms! Having friends over? Grab a seat and share a meal at our alfresco dining areas! Coliving accommodation in Singapore has never been this convenient!

Official named facilities
Say Hi
Your adventure starts here! Come chat with our friendly lyf guards or grab a bite while you check in with our mobile app.

CONNECT - COWORKING LOUNGE
Hangout with other guests here at Connect, our communal lounge that also doubles as a co-working space. It's the perfect spot to bang out some work or to wind down after hours and chill in one of our plush lounge chairs!

MEET / HUDDLE / COLLAB
Collaboration inspires innovation. These meeting rooms are the perfect environment for a brainstorming sesh with the team. These flexible rooms can be combined to perfectly accommodate small scale events such as mini workshops and product launches.

TO-GATHER - EVENT LAWN
A limitless versatile lawn to suit all your workout needs. Get your heart pumping with an intense HIIT class or wind down with some sunset yoga.

BOND - SOCIAL KITCHEN
The kitchen is the heart of the home – cook up a storm in our fully equipped social kitchen and host dinner parties at our dreamy alfresco dining area. Trade tips and tricks with other avid cooks and bring your cooking to the next level! 

TEMPORARILY CLOSED TILL 31 MAY 2026

BURN - SOCIAL GYM
Slip into your active-wear and work up a sweat in our fully decked out gym. Stocked with all the essentials like kettlebells, pro suspension training kits, bosu balls, core bags, treadmill and dumbbells, our social gym is equipped with everything you need to feel the Burn.

WASH & HANG - LAUNDERETTE
Say goodbye to tedious laundry! Let these wonderful washers do the work for you and keep you smelling fresh 24/7! Pop your laundry in and head to the lounge for a quick read or grab a beer and chill out alfresco.

24/7 ON-CALL WELLNESS & SECURITY
For greater comfort and reassurance during your stay, round-the-clock health, wellness and security support including telehealth or non-emergency medical consultation, updates on health and security situations within the property vicinity or the destination you are travelling to is available a call away. More info here.

FOR GUESTS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENTS
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with physical impairments. Accessible rooms are designed for comfort, and safety is prioritized with conveniently located accessible toilets featuring clear emergency instructions. Lifts also ensure smooth navigation throughout the property.

 

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

FOR GUESTS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENTS
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with visual impairments, featuring braille signage in lifts to aid navigation. 

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

FOR YOUR STAY – WHAT'S PROVIDED
Pack light, skip the stress, and let us handle the basics while you get straight to enjoying your stay. Take a peek at the full list of in room goodies here.

View the full list of items available in your room here.

name: lyf Funan Singapore
tagline: Experience-Led Social Living in Singapore
description:
A stone’s throw away from City Hall MRT station and within the Central Business District, lyf Funan Singapore is a unique Singapore apartment hotel located in the newly-renovated Funan Mall. It is in proximity to an array of business and entertainment attractions and surrounded by a host of iconic landmarks from heritage sites to opulent art galleries.

 

lyf Funan Singapore redefines the apartment living experience. Whether you are just stopping by in Singapore for a few nights or staying for a few months, lyf goes beyond providing you a comfortable apartment with ensuite bathrooms and high speed Wi-Fi. Enjoy experience-led social living in Singapore with this hotel in Funan. Gain access to well-designed shared spaces and plug into a diverse and dynamic community of like-minded travellers and locals! lyf’s shared spaces range from open working spaces, a fully-equipped community kitchen, to a fun but functional gym. Participate in weekly events curated by the lyf team, get to know the local culture and live like a local if you wish.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
lyf Funan Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 6.58 kg CO2e per room night - amongst top-performing peers in Singapore.  
Water Footprint: 406.71 litres per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.

Location
For seasoned travellers who are constantly on the move, seeking the best hotels near City Hall in Singapore: lyf Funan Singapore is located in the experiential retail mall Funan, a stone’s throw away from City Hall MRT station and within the Central Business District. It is in proximity to an array of business and entertainment attractions and surrounded by a host of iconic landmarks from heritage sites to opulent art galleries.

Apartments
For young travel enthusiasts, thought leaders or entrepreneurs seeking for accommodation in a lifestyle hotel in Singapore: our apartments come packed with comfy beds, ensuite bathrooms and complimentary Wi-Fi. Whether you're travelling solo or in a group, our wide range of apartments fit individuals, couples, or groups!

Official room cards
One of a Kind (Studio) — 18 sqm.
Perfect for the couple that likes to snuggle, or for the individual who enjoys having his or her own space. Combining all the best elements of home with the modern and trendy amenities of a shared living space, One of a Kind is an ideal choice for travellers who are on the lookout for a co living space in Singapore.

Up and Down (Studio) — 18 sqm.
Do you love travelling with friends but still want the bed space to sprawl? This room provides both of you that spatial freedom, moonlight me-time, and the cosy comforts of co living spaces in Singapore, without the loneliness. The perfect bunk studio in Singapore to share with your travel companion.

lyf Style (Thematic Studio) — 18 sqm.
Who ever said a studio apartment in Singapore has to be boring and one dimensional? This gaming-themed room is equipped with a PlayStation game console and designed for the ultimate dusk-to-dawn gaming experience. Tired? Pull down the bed for a power nap or grab a quick shower in the ensuite bathroom. Don’t be surprised if neighbours start to drop by and hang out with you over a game; we create the best Singapore coliving experience!

One of a Kind Plus (Studio) — 27 sqm.
Perfect for the couple that likes to snuggle, or for the individual who enjoys having his or her own space, with a well-equipped kitchen and spacious dining area that doubles up as a work desk - the One of a Kind Plus Studio is the ideal choice for those looking to experience coliving in Singapore.

Whether you're looking to escape the humdrum of life, or dreaming up your next "Eureka!" moment, come live lyf here for the ultimate live, work and play experience!

Two of a Kind (2 Bedroom) — 43 sqm.
All about that ‘one of a kind’ situation, but upsized and served up alongside a private pantry, creating the best co living Singapore experience. Two of a Kind offers 2 bedroom accommodation in Singapore – perfect for four people, or just two if you prefer not to share.

All Together (2 Bedroom) — 41 sqm.
For travel enthusiasts seeking a two bedroom apartment in Singapore: The All Together 2-Bedroom apartment has the perfect co living accommodation for you to power through small group meetings and discussions or even an ideal option for your next holiday with your friends. In fact, you could live your whole life in here—and why not?

All Together (4 Bedroom) — 70 sqm.
These furnished apartments in Singapore are just what you need to brainstorm for new game-changing business ideas! With an interactive touch screen whiteboard and discussion space, you’ll be sure to actively engage a team of up to 6 persons in a conducive setting. 

 

Fret not if you're travelling on a holiday! The 4 bedroom apartment is outfitted with a well-equipped kitchenette and living area for you to enjoy gatherings with family and friends as well.

All Together (6 Bedroom Duplex) — 105 sqm.
Whether you're travelling with a large group of friends or visiting on business, experience our unique shared living apartments with our All Together 6 Bedroom Duplex, a group accommodation in Singapore unlike any other! 

Transit from a business meeting to a dinner party cook-off with ease, in our well-equipped kitchenette and a multi-functional living and dining space or organise gatherings with friends and co-workers. This apartment is perfect for those looking for cool spaces in Singapore.

Facilities
At lyf Funan Singapore, we love seeing you forge connections at our shared spaces. From open working areas to the shared kitchen, meet like-minded travellers and create unique points of interaction. Our co living rental in Singapore differs from any other apartment stay in Singapore by providing ample resources to engage and connect with a range of diverse individuals in a multitude of different settings, be it at any of our in house events, while you grab a cup of coffee or even when you visit the laundromat.

Official named facilities
say hi
Your lyf journey begins here! Say hi to our lyf guard and grab a cuppa and some local bites while you check-in with our mobile app.

CONNECT - COWORKING LOUNGE
Get comfy in the communal lounge: work if you must, but if it’s a break you’re after, there are indulgent couches to chill in and open spaces to work from.

bond - social kitchen

burn - social gym

24/7 ON-CALL WELLNESS & SECURITY

description:
Long Term Stay in Singapore

Looking for a short or long term stay in Singapore? Stay with us at lyf one-north where the action never stops! We’ve got something for everyone in our vibrant, interconnected ecosystem where everything is within reach.
 With tons of eateries conveniently located at Star Vista, Rochester Mall, Fusionopolis and Galaxis, you will be spoilt for choice! Need a drink? Timbre+ and Jimmy Monkey are just across the road. You can easily pop over for a nightcap without missing a beat.
 With a well-connected transport system, you can easily access the city via one-north MRT just minutes away. Go anywhere you would like to explore on our fully connected pedestrian paths, cycling tracks, and PMD access paths, all seamlessly linked.
 Pick one of our two apartment types: One of a Kind (Studio) or Level-Up (Loft), accommodating both short and long stays. Also, check out our facilities curated just for you! We have plenty of open spaces for you to work and chill, run conferences and meetings, as well as gather and hang out.
 Where are we? We’re only a 2-minute walk from one-north MRT and right next to the one-north offices, opposite Fusionopolis and Galaxis.

 Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

 Identity Verification Requirement
 In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.
 Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

 Ascott Clean360
lyf one-north Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here .

 Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 6.90 kg CO2e per room night - amongst top-performing peers in Singapore.
Water Footprint: 184.42 litres per room night - amongst top-performing peers in Singapore.

At lyf, we keep the gears running for you 24/7 so you can live, work, and play whenever you wish.

Featuring 324 units, lyf one-north Singapore is situated in the west, right next to the science and tech business parks. The CBD is only 30 minutes away via the Circle Line (CCL), with the closest MRT station, one-north, just a 2-minute walk away.

Shared Living in Singapore
 Find the space that fits your style! With two distinct apartment types to choose from, lyf one-north Singapore has everything you need to settle in comfortably.

 Our shared living in Singapore comes with a flat-screen TV with Chromecasting function to keep you entertained. A work desk and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi for a smooth work environment. Weekly housekeeping to keep your room clean, as well as mobile key access for convenient entry.

 Planning to bring your furry friends along? Just drop us a quick email beforehand, and we’ll get everything ready for a comfy stay for you and your pets!.

A perfect oasis for the couple who likes to snuggle or for the individual who enjoys a quiet space, the One of a Kind has everything a studio room in Singapore need for you to live comfortably, play creatively, and work efficiently.

Our Level Up lofts are perfect for individuals and pairs who want to work, socialise, and play. Work productively at our coliving spaces or take a break and join our community events. Amenities in lyf one-north Singapore
 Here are the facilities we have for you.

 In addition to shared apartments offered at lyf one-north Singapore, we have communal lounges for you to work or play. You can sweat it out in our well-equipped gym (Burn), wash your clothes in our laundromat (Wash & Hang), have a team huddle in our function rooms (Huddle & Collab), take an exercise class or join a festival on our green lawn (To-Gather), watch a concert at our amphitheatre (Meet), share a meal at our social kitchen (Bond), dip in our pool and have a BBQ with friends (Dip), gather and relax at our clubhouse for a game of chess and a cuppa (Hangout).

 Whatever you need, we’ve got it.

Say Hi (Level 1)
Arrive at lyf and let our lyf Guards usher you in. Refuel with a drink and some snacks from our Grab & Go counter while you seamlessly check-in via our app. You know we’ve thought of everything.

Connect - Coworking Lounge (Level 1)
Get comfy in the communal lounge: work if you must, but if it's a break you're after, there are indulgent couches to chill in and open working spaces to choose from.

Dip - Swimming Pool (Level 2)
Soak up the sun at our outdoor 25-metre lap pool, featuring sun decks to get that perfect tan. Once you’ve worked up an appetite, gather some friends and cook up a BBQ feast!

Wash & Hang - Launderette (Level 1)
Our Wash & Hang launderette makes daily chores easy. Let our machines do the heavy lifting for you while you read, chat, or chill with a drink while we get your clothes squeaky clean.

Bond - Social Kitchen (Level 2)
Nothing brings people together like good food in the social kitchen – whip up culinary storms or pick up new recipes from like-minded travellers from around the globe. Here at lyf, food is our common ground. Planning your next feast? Check out our meal prep guide for inspiration!

Burn - Social Gym (Level 1)
It never gets any easier, you just get better! After a long day’s work, burn off your calories and all your excess energy at our gym and feel absolutely great afterwards.

Huddle & Collab (Level 1)
Hatch your next great big idea in our purposefully designed meeting rooms, which are perfect for a team huddle or to take on a conference call with your global counterparts.

Meet - Amphitheatre (Level 1)
Think outdoors, and think BIG. Our terraced outdoor amphitheatre is the perfect backdrop to host large concerts and events.

Hang Out (Rooftop)
Space, we all need it. Here’s ours!
 A gorgeous green lawn to have your favourite outdoor activities like yoga, Zumba, and HIIT classes. You can even run events like pop-up markets and festivals with a view.

Unwind (Rooftop)
Don’t tell anyone, but here’s our secret hang out spot: unwind!
 Sneak up here anytime for special music and movie events, exercise classes, and market fairs.
 A clubhouse and pavilion for a game and a cuppa - no secret handshake needed!

Ye Olde Cow - Food Truck (Level 1)
lyf's a whole lot better with food, and we're here to prove it! Our dry-aged beef burgers food truck is your ticket to taste paradise. From mouthwatering bites to liquid delights, we've got your cravings covered.

24/7 ON-CALL WELLNESS & SECURITY
For greater comfort and reassurance during your stay, round-the-clock health, wellness and security support including telehealth or non-emergency medical consultation, updates on health and security situations within the property vicinity or the destination you are travelling to is available a call away. The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with physical impairments. Accessible rooms are designed for comfort, and safety is prioritized with conveniently located accessible toilets featuring clear emergency instructions. Wheelchair ramps and lifts ensure smooth navigation throughout the property.

name: Oakwood Studios Singapore
tagline: Serviced Apartments in Orchard
description:
Experience contemporary living at Oakwood Studios Singapore, an award-winning serviced apartment property situated directly on Orchard Road, the city's premier shopping and entertainment district. Our central location places you moments from renowned retail destinations, diverse dining options, and vibrant leisure activities, ensuring you are at the heart of the city's pulse. For guests seeking medical care, Mount Elizabeth Hospital is conveniently located just a short walk from our doorstep, making us an ideal choice for those requiring easy access to medical facilities.

Choose from 96 stylishly designed serviced apartments, including Studio, One-Bedroom, and Two-Bedroom options, each crafted to offer comfort and convenience. Every apartment features a spacious private balcony, providing a pleasant outdoor space. Inside, you will find a fully equipped modern kitchen, complete with a combination microwave, hob, refrigerator, and coffee machine, allowing you to prepare meals at your leisure. A comprehensive home entertainment system and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi ensure both relaxation and connectivity throughout your residence.

Oakwood Studios Singapore offers a comprehensive range of exclusive facilities and services designed to enhance your experience. Take a refreshing dip in our rooftop swimming pool, offering a tranquil escape above the city, or maintain your fitness routine at the well-equipped rooftop gym. Guests can enjoy our barbecue facilities for outdoor dining and social gatherings, or relax in the inviting residents' lounge. For your convenience, a self-service launderette is available, and our 24-hour reception team is always on hand to assist you.

We are committed to providing a sophisticated, secure, and inclusive environment. We understand that pets are part of the family, which is why Oakwood Studios Singapore is a pet-friendly serviced apartment (with prior arrangement and applicable charges). Discover a truly distinctive living experience that blends comfort and convenience in the heart of the city.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Third Person Occupancy Charge

For any additional person, aged 12 years and above, sharing the existing bed or sleeps in the apartment, an additional occupancy charge of $20+ per night will be applied. 

This charge covers the provision of extra amenities. 

For guest that opts for an extra bed in the apartment, the charge will not be applied. 

A Safe Sanctuary for All - Oakwood Studios Singapore is certified SG Clean by National Environment Agency. The SG Clean quality mark is our unwavering commitment to guests by adhering to a rigorous sanitation and hygiene checklist and an assurance of the health of our associates. The property is also part of Oakwood Clean360, a robust hygiene programme and received a Trusted Cleanliness badge by TrustYou, where the property is assessed based on public recommendations and government regulations. Oakwood Studios Singapore welcomes all guests regardless of vaccination status. The property reserves the rights to review vaccination records for documentation purpose only.

Location
Oakwood Studios Singapore offers a highly sought-after address at 18 Mount Elizabeth, placing you in the vibrant heart of Singapore's renowned Orchard Road district. This prime location ensures an extensive array of world-class shopping centres, exquisite dining establishments, and diverse entertainment options surround you. For guests requiring medical access, our serviced apartments are exceptionally convenient: Mount Elizabeth Hospital and the Paragon Medical Centre are just a short 3 to 4-minute walk from our doorstep.

The surrounding area provides unparalleled access to major commercial and leisure hubs. The residence is ideally situated between two major MRT stations: Orchard MRT Station is approximately 5 to 10 minutes away, and Somerset MRT Station is similarly accessible within 7 to 10 minutes. These excellent transport links connect you effortlessly to major attractions such as Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, and Sentosa Island. This central positioning ensures you can navigate Singapore's dynamic energy with confidence and ease.

description:
Welcome home to Oakwood Premier Raffles Place Singapore, a new 5-star hotel in Singapore.

Located within CapitaSpring at 88 Market Street, Level 9, Oakwood Premier Raffles Place Singapore occupies a prime address in the heart of the Raffles Place Central Business District. Our 299-room property spans seven levels and offers elevated views of the city skyline. 

 

Built on the foundation of reliability, where the Oakwood brand has long been defined by its philosophy of Home+Beyond, we endeavour to deliver comforts of home, enhanced by hotel-style service and thoughtful design, offering guests a stay that feels familiar yet elevated, personal and refined. 

Our lobby area, thoughtfully conceived as a living room, invites guests to unwind and be surrounded with plush furnishings, intimate seating corners and residential-style touches to evoke a sense of belonging and ease. 

Oakwood Premier Raffles Place Singapore also features a comprehensive range of facilities designed to support both work and wellbeing, with amenities including a Fitness Park, Garden Barbecue area, Launderette, Swimming Pool and a 24-hour concierge service. 

 

Enjoy easy access to The Oak Room, perfect for a morning coffee, a midday pause or an evening tipple. Club guests may retreat to Oak Reserve, an exclusive space designed for quiet moments, with all-day coffee, tea and snacks, alongside evening drinks and canapes as the night falls. 

With attentive service from our Oakwood GEMs and details carefully considered throughout your stay, you can always count on the comfort, reliability and familiar sense of home that travels with you, wherever you are in the world.

Location
Oakwood Premier Raffles Place Singapore is situated within CapitaSpring, a landmark integrated development in the heart of the financial district. In addition to the residence, CapitaSpring houses Grade A offices, retail outlets and dining options all under one roof. On the ground floor, the City Room features an impressive 18 metre high atrium with landscaped greenery, welcoming both residents and the public.

 

Just a two minute walk from Raffles Place MRT Interchange and seven minutes from Telok Ayer MRT Station, the property is seamlessly connected to Singapore’s public transport network, offering easy access to the central business district, Marina Bay Financial Centre and the shopping precinct of Orchard Road.

 

Residents can also explore the nearby civic district. A short five minute stroll brings you to the Singapore River, where the historic Cavenagh Bridge leads to iconic cultural landmarks, including the Asian Civilisations Museum, Arts House, Victoria Concert Hall and the National Gallery.

Apartments
After a full day in the city, return to the comforting embrace of Oakwood Premier Raffles Place Singapore, where calming tones and contemporary elegance create a welcoming retreat above the bustle. 

We present a curated collection of well-appointed accommodation tailored to the diverse needs of today's travellers. Ranging from Deluxe and Premier Rooms to spacious Junior, Premier and Executive Suites, be inspired by refined interiors and elevated in-room amenities for enhanced comfort. Each space is designed as a smart, flexible living space that transit seamlessly between work and rest. Paired with floor-to-ceiling city views and comfortable lounge areas with dedicated workspace, our guestroom are perfect to supporting both productivity and relaxation. 

Our flora headboard artwork invites guests on a garden-inspired journey that reinteprets everyday surroundings. Set within a contemporary take on a turn-of-the-century tropical conservatory, the design brings lush natural indoors, creating comfort and connection to nature.

Every detail is considered to provide a dependable sanctuary, so you can always feel at home.

name: Somerset Bencoolen Singapore
tagline: Serviced Apartments in Singapore
description:
Singapore, a dynamic metropolis where gleaming skyscrapers harmonise with historic architecture, offers a truly unique travel experience. It is within this captivating blend of urban sophistication and natural beauty that you will find Somerset Bencoolen Singapore, a welcoming serviced apartment complex located at 51 Bencoolen Street. Our central business district address offers exceptional convenience, putting you just 27 metres from Bencoolen MRT Station and ensuring effortless travel across the city. This prime location allows easy access to cultural landmarks, shopping precincts like Orchard Road, and a diverse culinary scene, catering to every palate.

Our 110-unit residence offers a choice of comfortable 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed to feel like a true home away from home. These spacious living spaces are perfect for both short and extended stays. Each apartment features a fully-equipped modern kitchen, allowing you the freedom and flexibility to prepare your own meals. You will also find an en-suite bathroom, multi-split air-conditioning, and an in-room electronic safe. Stay connected throughout your visit with complimentary Wi-Fi, ensuring a refined and independent residential experience.

Guests at Somerset Bencoolen Singapore enjoy access to a comprehensive range of exclusive facilities and signature services designed to enhance your stay. Maintain your fitness routine in our fully equipped gymnasium, or take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool, a peaceful oasis amidst the city. Younger guests benefit from a dedicated children's wading pool and playground. For business travellers, our well-appointed business centre services provide a productive environment. Embrace the Ascott lifestyle with our engaging residents' programmes, designed to enrich your stay and connect you with the local culture and community.

We ensure a seamless and secure residential experience with 24-hour reception and security. Daily housekeeping services are provided (except on Sundays and public holidays), and a convenient launderette is available. We also offer accessible rooms and services for guests with physical impairments, as well as airport transfers and babysitting upon request. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our dedication to responsible tourism. We invite you to experience the comfort and convenience of Somerset Bencoolen Singapore, available at the best rates when booked directly.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Somerset Bencoolen Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 18.26 kg per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore. 
Water Footprint: 296.44 litres per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.

Location
Somerset Bencoolen Singapore offers an ideal base for exploring the Lion City, perfectly positioned at 51 Bencoolen Street within Singapore's bustling central business district. Our location places you at the crossroads of culture, education, and commerce. For cultural immersion, the National Gallery Singapore and the Singapore Art Museum are both easily accessible on foot or by a quick bus ride. The vibrant cultural enclave of Little India, with its unique shops and aromatic eateries, is just a comfortable 12-minute walk away, offering a sensory journey into Singapore's heritage. The prestigious Singapore Management University (SMU) is also within a short walk, adding an intellectual vibrancy to the area.

The surrounding area provides unparalleled access to major retail and dining precincts. For a unique shopping experience, Mustafa Shopping Centre, a 24-hour retail haven, is a convenient 10-minute drive away. Orchard Road, Singapore's premier shopping belt, is just two train stops from Dhoby Ghaut station (an 8-minute walk from our doorstep). The immediate vicinity around Bencoolen Street offers a plethora of dining options, from casual hawker fare to upscale restaurants, reflecting Singapore's reputation as a culinary paradise.

Apartments
After a day of exploring the beautiful city, return to Somerset Bencoolen Singapore to refresh yourself. The 110-unit serviced residence is fitted with apartments in a variety of sizes to cater to all travellers. Guests can choose from a range of apartment types and services to customise their stay at our residence.

Apartments range from spacious 1-bedroom apartments to luxurious 2-bedroom apartments that come with a well-equipped kitchen and en-suite bathrooms furnished with complimentary bath amenities. Every apartment is also fitted with a separate living and dining space, an LCD television with cable channels, air-conditioning, daily housekeeping services and complimentary wireless Internet connectivity.

Official FAQ (property-page JSON-LD FAQPage)
What is the standard check-in and check-out time for Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Check-in is from 3PM and Check-out is at 12PM. Early check-in and Late check-out request will be subjected to availability and may be chargeable.
Is the Front Desk available 24/7? Our Front Desk is manned 24hours and will be able to assist our guests anytime.
What is the smoking policy for Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Somerset Bencoolen Singapore has a non-smoking policy, smoking is strictly prohibited.
What types of apartments are available at Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Guests can choose from comfortable 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments, each featuring a fully-equipped kitchen and en-suite bathroom, designed for a comfortable stay.
Does Somerset Bencoolen Singapore cater to guests with physical impairments? Yes, the property offers accessible rooms and services designed to accommodate guests with physical impairments, ensuring a comfortable and inclusive stay for everyone.
Is there a carpark available at Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? There is a carpark available, however as it is not under the purview of Somerset Bencoolen Singapore, there will be charges.
Are baby cots and extra bed available? Yes, baby cots are available upon request but subjected to availability. Yes, extra bed are also available upon request at additionally charges, subjected to availability and can only be accomodated in certain room types.
How often is the Housekeeping Service (Per week) at Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Housekeeping service at Somerset Bencoolen Singapore is daily from 9am to 5pm except Sundays and Public Holidays.
Does Somerset Bencoolen Singapore have a launderette? Yes, there is a launderette room on level 5 and tokens can be purchased from Front Office (SGD8 per token).
What amenities are offered at Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Guests can enjoy a fully equipped gymnasium, an outdoor swimming pool, a children's wading pool, an outdoor garden, and business centre services. All apartments include complimentary wireless internet connectivity.
How do I get to Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Somerset Bencoolen Singapore is 1-min walk away from Bencoolen MRT Station (Downtown Line), 3-min walk away from Bras Basah MRT Station (Circle Line) and 8-min walk away from Dhoby Ghaut MRT Station (North-South Line, North-East Line, Circle Line).
How close is Somerset Bencoolen Singapore to public transport? The property is exceptionally well-connected, located just 27 metres from Bencoolen MRT Station. Bras Basah MRT Station is a three-minute walk, and Dhoby Ghaut MRT Station is an eight-minute walk away.
Are there any major attractions near Somerset Bencoolen Singapore? Absolutely. You are within walking distance of the National Gallery Singapore, Singapore Art Museum, Little India, and Singapore Management University. Orchard Road is also just two train stops away.
Are the Halal restaurants available nearby the hotel? Yes, the restaurant by the lobby, Putra Minang, is halal-certified.
Is there a dedicated prayer room? No, but all room have a prayer direction sticker.
Does all rooms have prayer direction marked? Yes, all rooms have a dedicated prayer direction marked.
Are there any prayer kit available? Yes, we have both female and male prayer garment for rent, alongside prayer mat, quran, tasbih (prayer beads) and ruhal (quran stand).

name: Citadines Balestier Singapore
tagline: Serviced Apartments in Balestier
description:
Balestier is an eclectic neighbourhood in Singapore that offers everything from a rich bowl of local laksa noodles at the nearby Whampoa Hawker Centre to a cup of latte art and soy cappuccino along the shopping belt on Orchard Road.

Our serviced apartments cater to various needs, from solo explorers to couples seeking a comfortable base. Choose a cosy Studio Premier apartment, offering 30 square metres of thoughtfully designed space, or opt for a more expansive One-Bedroom Executive apartment at 35 square metres. For even more space to relax, the One-Bedroom Premier apartment offers 40 square metres. Each apartment is fully furnished and features a well-equipped kitchenette, an en-suite bathroom with fresh towels and toiletries, multi-split air-conditioning, a hair dryer, and a steam iron with an ironing board. All apartments are non-smoking, ensuring a pleasant environment for every guest.

Beyond your private apartment, a host of facilities and services await to enhance your stay. Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool or maintain your fitness routine at the indoor fitness zone, complemented by an outdoor fitness corner which includes a 100-metre running track. Families will appreciate the children's playground and water play area, providing ample space for younger guests to enjoy. For social gatherings, a barbecue pavilion and a welcoming Residents' Lounge are available, fostering a sense of community.

For your convenience, a self-service launderette is available for a small charge per use. Housekeeping services are provided three times a week, excluding Sundays and public holidays. The property ensures your peace of mind with 24-hour security, CCTV surveillance, and proximity keycard access. Citadines Balestier Singapore is also pet-friendly, welcoming your furry companions with additional charges and size limits. Discover the comfort and convenience of a serviced apartment designed for modern living. We invite you to make Citadines Balestier Singapore your preferred address in the city.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Citadines Balestier Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 8.88 kg per room night - amongst top-performing peers in Singapore.
Water Footprint: 310.16 litres per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.

Location
Citadines Balestier Singapore places you in the heart of the lively Balestier neighbourhood, a district celebrated for its rich heritage, diverse culinary scene, and charming shophouses. This area offers a genuine glimpse into Singaporean life, blending historical architecture with modern conveniences. From traditional eateries serving local favourites to unique cafes, Balestier provides an authentic experience just moments from your doorstep.

Reaching our serviced apartments from Singapore Changi Airport (SIN) is straightforward. A taxi journey typically takes around 30 minutes and costs approximately SGD 25. Alternatively, you can take the MRT train to Newton MRT Station, a journey of about 40 minutes. From Newton MRT Station Exit A, head to the bus stop on Scotts Road and board Bus 124, alighting five stops later at Balestier Towers (Opposite Block 104).

Our central location ensures excellent connectivity to the rest of Singapore. The nearest MRT station, Farrer Park (North East Line), is a mere three-minute walk away, offering swift access across the city. Novena MRT Station (North-South Line) is a convenient five-minute drive or a 16-minute walk from the property, providing access to the Novena hub for shopping and amenities. Newton MRT Station (North-South Line and Downtown Line) is an eight-minute drive or an 11-minute bus ride away, connecting you directly to the Central Business District and the iconic Marina Bay area.

For those looking to explore further, a direct bus service, Bus 124, runs from directly opposite the property to Orchard Road, Singapore's premier shopping belt, with a journey time of approximately 12 to 16 minutes. This makes it incredibly easy to enjoy high-street fashion, international dining, and entertainment.

Within the immediate vicinity, you can immerse yourself in local culture. The renowned Whampoa Hawker Centre, famous for its local laksa noodles and other delicious fare, is just a short walk from Balestier Road. The Novena hub, with its array of supermarkets and retail options, is also within a 15-minute walk. Explore the unique Chinese-Baroque shophouses and historical temples that line Balestier Road, offering wonderful photo opportunities and insights into the area's past.

Whether you are here for business or leisure, Citadines Balestier Singapore provides a perfectly situated base to experience the best of this dynamic city. Plan your journey and discover the rich tapestry of Singapore from our convenient location.

Apartments
After a day of meetings, conference calls, errands and site visits, take a deep breath and recharge at Citadines Balestier Singapore. Residents can choose from a range of apartment types and services to make their stay a memorable one, our seamless combination of upscale urban designs and homely amenities makes us the ideal accommodation choice for anyone seeking centrally located and spacious apart’hotels in Singapore.

 

Apartment types range from Studios to One-Bedrooms. While some of these apartments come with kitchen and en-suite bathroom, they also have floor-to-ceiling windows that offer views of the nearby Novena district and Balestier area. Each apartment offers a living and dining space, flat screen television with cable channels, air-conditioning, thrice weekly housekeeping services and complimentary WiFi connectivity.

Official room cards
Studio Premier — 30 sqm.
Each Studio Premier apartment comes fully-furnished in a contemporary yet timeless colour palette that will invigorate the early mornings and calm the quiet evenings. The modern furniture further complements this detail and is the perfect home for professionals or a couple on leisure travel seeking spacious and functional studio serviced apartments in Singapore.

 

In addition to a cosy bed wrapped in fresh sheets, necessary workspace and seating amenities, a fully-equipped kitchenette will ensure that guests will have all the comforts of home abroad.

One-Bedroom Executive — 35 sqm.
The fully-furnished One-Bedroom Executive apartment defines generous living space, the perfect retreat for independent travellers and young families. 

 

This one-bedroom serviced apartment in Singapore is inclusive of necessary workspace, a separate bedroom, living and kitchen that provides a sense of familiarity in the comforts of home.

 

A personal washing machine with dryer is available in this apartment, making it extra convenient to get ready for the next day's outfit while attending to other errands, or while watching television.

One-Bedroom Premier — 40 sqm.
This One-Bedroom Premier apartment in Singapore will make guests feel as though they have simply picked the keys up to a new life in Singapore. 

 

Each One-Bedroom Premier apartment is fully-furnished and comes with a well-equipped kitchen to whip up favourite family meals or a comfort one-bowl dish, alongside a personal washing machine and dryer. A spacious and separate living room area will also open the space up to entertaining friends after dinner or lounging around. A twin bed suitable for sharing will also promise a good night's rest to reset for the next work day. 

 

Light pastel colours with hints of seafoam and cream cover the space, calming the senses and refreshing the mind. Modern furniture further complements this detail and easily helps guests around the world settle into the city. For any need to stay connected to the rest of the world, complimentary WiFi is available in all apartment types.

Facilities
Residents have access to an outdoor fitness area complete with a 100m running track. There are also child-friendly facilities on level 6 of the residence for families with children. This, combined with the resources in our serviced suites in Singapore, alongside the on-site launderette and all other amenities, aims to make your stay a quality one.

name: Citadines Fusionopolis Singapore
tagline: Serviced Residence in Singapore
description:
Discover contemporary living at Citadines Fusionopolis Singapore, a distinguished serviced residence designed for both dynamic business and refined leisure travellers. Strategically situated within the One-North business park, a 30-hectare mixed-use development, our property offers a seamless blend of innovation and a sophisticated lifestyle. This thriving research and development hub is home to over 400 companies, creating a vibrant atmosphere for residents. Commuting across Singapore is exceptionally convenient, as the One-North Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) Station is located directly within the building, ensuring effortless access to the city's key financial and entertainment destinations.

Our thoughtfully designed one-bedroom loft units offer a spacious, inviting retreat. Each apartment features chic interiors with high ceilings, creating an airy, open feel that signifies contemporary luxury. Guests will appreciate the separate living and dining areas, a fully-equipped modern kitchen for preparing meals, and a comfortable bedroom for restful nights. For residential ease, every apartment includes a washing machine and dryer, along with an en-suite bathroom appointed with fresh towels and complimentary toiletries, ensuring a complete sense of domestic independence. All residences are non-smoking, guaranteeing a pleasant environment for everyone.

Beyond your private sanctuary, Citadines Fusionopolis Singapore offers a range of exclusive facilities and signature services to enhance your stay. Guests can maintain their fitness routine at our outdoor fitness corner. The surrounding development boasts a variety of high-quality food and beverage outlets, retail amenities, a supermarket, and a medical centre, ensuring all your daily needs are met without having to venture far. For added convenience, we offer laundry and dry cleaning services, as well as flexible concierge assistance, including babysitting and courier services.

We prioritise your comfort and absolute security with 24/7 on-call wellness and security services, providing complete peace of mind throughout your visit. Additional conveniences include an airport transfer service for smooth arrivals and departures, and a car park within Fusionopolis One (charges apply). Our dedicated team provides professional housekeeping service three times a week to maintain the pristine condition of your residence, ensuring a seamless blend of attentive service and residential comfort.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Citadines Fusionopolis Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 17.92 kg per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore. 
Water Footprint: 433.34 litres per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.

Location
Citadines Fusionopolis Singapore enjoys a truly strategic position within One-North, Singapore's thriving research and development hub. This dynamic precinct is a carefully planned environment where innovation, work, and leisure seamlessly intertwine, providing a sophisticated lifestyle. Guests will find themselves surrounded by a comprehensive array of amenities, including diverse dining options, convenient retail outlets, and essential services, ensuring a comfortable and productive stay. For local leisure and cultural immersion, Holland Village, known for its lively dining and retail scene, is just a 4-minute subway ride away. Similarly, Haw Par Villa, with its unique cultural park, is just 4 minutes away by subway.

The immediate vicinity of Fusionopolis offers a rich tapestry of professional and recreational experiences. You can explore the various precincts within one-north, such as Biopolis for biomedical sciences or Mediapolis for media and infocomm, featuring walkable paths and green spaces like one-north Park, perfect for a relaxing stroll. For those attending educational or medical institutions, the National University of Singapore (NUS) is approximately a 14-minute walk or a 10-minute drive from the residence. The National University Hospital (NUH) is also nearby and can be reached via an underpass from the MRT station, offering significant convenience.

Apartments
A retreat for savvy independent travellers on extended stay, the serviced residence offers a range of spacious one-bedroom loft units, featuring chic interiors with high ceilings, separate living and dining areas, kitchen and bedroom.

tagline: Hotel in Rochor
description:
Discover contemporary living at Citadines Rochor Singapore, a distinguished hotel situated at the gateway to the vibrant Little India district. As an integral part of Tekka Place, an integrated development, guests benefit from a curated selection of retail, dining, fitness, and cultural experiences right on their doorstep. The property boasts exceptional connectivity, with Rochor MRT Station (Downtown Line) just a 1-minute walk away, and Little India MRT Station (North East and Downtown Lines) a convenient 5-minute stroll. This prime position ensures effortless travel to Singapore's Central Business District and other key attractions across the city.

Our elegantly designed accommodations cater to both business and leisure travellers, offering a variety of comfortable living spaces. Choose from well-appointed Studios, spacious One-bedroom rooms, or flexible Dual-key rooms, ideal for larger groups seeking interconnected living. Each room provides a private sanctuary, complete with a fully-equipped kitchenette and a private bathroom, ensuring a relaxing and independent retreat after a day of city exploration. Step outside and immerse yourself in the rich cultural tapestry of Little India, exploring ornate Hindu temples and savouring authentic Indian cuisine.

Guests at Citadines Rochor Singapore can enjoy a comprehensive range of exclusive facilities designed for comfort and convenience. Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool, maintain your fitness routine at the well-equipped fitness corner, or relax in the inviting Residents' Lounge. For those who prefer to prepare their own meals, the Residents' Kitchen offers a shared space with full cooking facilities. A self-service laundrette is also available, fostering a sense of domestic ease.

Ornate Hindu temples, goldsmith shops, sari stores and flower stalls – these are just some of the sights to be found in the perennially vibrant Little India. Revel in the bohemian vibe found in the maze of side streets and sample dishes commonly found across India. Make time to visit the 24-hour shopping mall Mustafa Centre, home to 300,000 products spanning from electronics to groceries, textiles and jewelries. For a truly local experience, head to Tekka Centre, Singapore’s largest indoor “wet market” that is chock-a-block with stalls selling fresh produce from around the region. Diagonally across the Rochor River is LASALLE College of the Arts. It is worth a visit for its striking architecture that resembles a massive black box turned inside out to retain a connection to the surrounding streets.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Citadines Rochor Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here. 

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 7.24 kg per room night - amongst top-performing peers in Singapore.  
Water Footprint: 355.47 litres per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.

Location
Citadines Rochor Singapore is ideally situated at the entrance to the culturally rich Little India district, offering a prime position integrated within the modern Tekka Place development. This location provides a dynamic blend of historical charm and contemporary urban living. The immediate neighbourhood is a sensory delight, brimming with traditional shops, authentic eateries, and vibrant temples. Guests can easily explore iconic landmarks such as the 24-hour Mustafa Centre, a sprawling shopping complex offering an incredible array of products, located less than 1 kilometre away. Just a short walk away is Tekka Centre, a bustling indoor market renowned for its fresh produce and popular food court.

The surrounding area ensures effortless access to culture, arts, and essential services. For those interested in arts and education, the architecturally striking LASALLE College of the Arts and the heritage precinct of Bugis and Bras Basah are also within easy reach. Essential conveniences are close at hand: the Care Clinic is just a 5-minute walk from the property. This strategic spot ensures you are ideally placed to experience Singapore's diverse offerings, whether your focus is commerce, culture, or sophisticated leisure.

Apartments
After a day out, returning to Citadines Rochor Singapore is evocative of a warm welcome home. Inspired by the surrounding neighbourhood of Little India, each of its 320 units takes design cues from its environment, subtly embodying the essence of the culture and everyday objects into the forms, patterns and textures throughout the spaces. 

 

From Studios to Lofts and One-Bedroom rooms, the accommodation options offer something for every traveller. Each has a living area and an en suite bathroom, while the floor-to-ceiling windows look out to different views of the neighbourhood.

Official room cards
Studio — 20 sqm.
The sleeping area is fitted with a queen-sized bed while the living space has a couch, armchair and coffee table. Cleverly tucked away is a microwave oven and mini fridge. Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to the city, also serving to flood the apartment with natural daylight.

Kindly note that all rooms are unable to accommodate an extra bed.

Studio Twin — 20 sqm.
It offers a sleeping area, work station and en suite bathroom. The sleeping area is fitted with two single beds and the work station has a desk and chair. Cleverly tucked away is a microwave oven and mini fridge.

Kindly note that all rooms are unable to accommodate an extra bed.

Studio Executive — 20 sqm.
Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to the city, also serving to flood the apartment with natural daylight. Design accents such as colourful carpets, wallcoverings and upholstery add pops of colour to an otherwise cool colour palette.

Kindly note that all rooms are unable to accommodate an extra bed.

Studio Premier — 20 sqm.
Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to Tekka Place’s garden, also serving to flood the apartment with natural daylight. This further highlights the design accents, such as colourful carpets and upholstery, juxtaposed against a cool palette.

Kindly note that all rooms are unable to accommodate an extra bed.

One-Bedroom Deluxe Loft — 25 sqm.
Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to the city, also serving to flood the apartment with natural daylight. Look out for the contemporary-styled pendant light hanging down over the void, giving the space an interesting twist.

Kindly note that all rooms are unable to accommodate an extra bed.

One-Bedroom Premier  — 38 sqm.
The bedroom is fitted with a queen-sized bed while the living room has a two-seater sofa, armchair and coffee table. The fully-equipped kitchen comes with a sink, microwave oven, hob and fridge, where guests can prepare meals and enjoy it at the four-seater dining table. An in-unit washer-dryer means laundry can be easily done within the apartment too. 

 

Floor-to-ceiling windows look out to the city, also serving to flood the apartment with natural daylight. 

Kindly note that all rooms are unable to accommodate an extra bed.

Two-Bedroom Premier (Dual Key) — 58 sqm.
Step into the two-bedroom dual key room, where style meets functionality. Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows, opening to sweeping city views in natural daylight, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.

 

Kindly note that the apartment will not be able to accommodate an extra bed.

Facilities
Guests are welcome to rest and relax in the Residents’ Lounge. Alternatively, choose to either clock laps in the swimming pool or work out in the well-equipped Fitness Corner.

Official named facilities
Fitness Corner
Work on strength or stamina at the well-equipped fitness corner that overlooks the swimming pool.

Launderette
Fitted out with washers and dryers, the launderette is the place to go to prepare outfits for the next day’s adventures. Charges apply.

Outdoor Swimming Pool
Soak off the heat, work on that tan or do laps in the inviting, 25m-long swimming pool.

Residents' Kitchen
Cook up a storm at this shared facility. Generously-sized sitting areas means visitors are welcome to partake in the prepared feast.

Residents' Lounge
An extension of the apartment, the indoor Residents’ Lounge has comfortable seating areas ideal for a quiet catch-up or some alone-time.

24/7 ON-CALL WELLNESS & SECURITY
For greater comfort and reassurance during your stay, round-the-clock health, wellness and security support including telehealth or non-emergency medical consultation, updates on health and security situations within the property vicinity or the destination you are travelling to is available a call away. More info here.

FOR GUESTS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENTS
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with physical impairments and mobility needs. Our accessible rooms feature spacious layouts, grab railes, and low-level facilities to ensure convenience for all guests with mobility needs. Our team is also fully trained to support guests with disabilities, ensuring a comfortable and inclusive experience throughout their stay. 

 

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

FOR GUESTS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENTS
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with visual impairments. The lifts are equipped with Braille signage, ensuring visually impaired guests to easily identify floors and access buttons, enhancing convenience and independence during their stay.

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

IN-ROOM ESSENTIALS
Your space comes fully equipped with all the essentials and thoughtful touches you need for a comfortable stay, ready for you from the moment you arrive.

name: Citadines Science Park Singapore
tagline: Hotel Residences in Singapore Science Park
description:
Discover contemporary living at Citadines Science Park Singapore, a distinguished serviced residence offering a harmonious blend of comfort and convenience. Perfectly positioned within the vibrant Singapore Science Park, this prime location provides immediate access to a dynamic hub of innovation and business. The property is surrounded by lush green spaces and the contemporary retail and dining options at Geneo, creating a refreshing, sophisticated urban atmosphere. Guests benefit from easy access to local attractions and primary transport links, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable stay for both business and leisure pursuits.

Our hotel residence features 250 thoughtfully designed apartments that cater to a variety of preferences and needs. Choose from highly functional studio apartments, stylish lofts, or spacious one-bedroom apartments, each offering a comfortable, contemporary living space. Every residence is air-conditioned and includes a private bathroom, a flat-screen television, and a dedicated work desk. Selected units also offer a well-equipped kitchenette, ideal for more extended stays or those who prefer the independence of preparing their own meals, creating a practical and refined environment.

Beyond your private apartment, Citadines Science Park Singapore provides an extensive array of exclusive facilities and services designed to enhance your stay. Maintain your fitness routine at our well-equipped fitness corner or take a refreshing dip in our stunning hotel infinity pool. Offering a serene escape, this Singapore infinity pool is the perfect spot to unwind after a busy day. For those travelling for work, our shared workspace and professional meeting rooms offer ideal environments for increased productivity. Guests can also enjoy the residents' lounge, a perfect spot for relaxation or informal networking, along with additional conveniences, including a launderette and a garden barbecue area.

Our commitment to your comfort extends to practical services and enhanced security. Benefit from 24/7 on-call wellness and security services and a 24-hour reception. Housekeeping services are provided three times weekly (excluding Sundays and public holidays), alongside laundry and dry cleaning services. While there is no in-house restaurant, the surrounding Geneo complex offers a diverse selection of food and beverage outlets, including Pyroast Café and Hawkerlab, providing ample dining choices just moments from your door. Experience the thoughtful amenities and attentive service that define this excellent choice for your visit.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Citadines Science Park Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Location
Citadines Science Park Singapore enjoys a strategic position within the dynamic Singapore Science Park, a thriving hub for innovation and business. Our serviced residence is part of the modern Geneo complex, offering guests immediate access to a curated selection of high-quality retail, food and beverage outlets, and appealing green spaces. This convenient setting provides a balanced environment for both work and sophisticated leisure. You will find several leading tertiary institutions, prominent hospitals, and various parks within easy reach. Furthermore, popular leisure attractions such as Gardens by the Bay, Haw Par Villa, and Universal Studios Singapore are all accessible within a comfortable commuting time.

The immediate neighbourhood ensures excellent proximity to essential services and cultural pursuits. The area offers a wealth of amenities, including diverse dining options, which contribute to a comfortable and productive stay. Specifically, the National University Hospital (NUH) is located nearby, and educational institutions such as the National University of Singapore (NUS) are easily accessible. This prime location, coupled with the property's dedicated shuttle and public transport access, ensures effortless exploration of the city's key destinations.

Apartments
Citadines Science Park Singapore offers modern and chic serviced apartments that provide a cosy stay for travellers. Located in Science Park, part of the vibrant Greater One-North community, the area is a hub for researchers and developers. The One-Bedroom apartments  offer spacious living areas and stylish interiors, complete with fully equipped kitchens, high-speed Wi-Fi, and bathrooms, making them ideal for extended stays. Other room types available include:  studio apartments, which are compact and affordable, as well as loft apartments, which offer a more experiential stay. On-site services include airport transportation and laundry, making it one of the finest apart hotels Singapore has to offer. Guests can enjoy the perfect blend of home comfort and hotel-level services.

These amenities cater to diverse guests' needs and ensure their stay is relaxing and hassle-free making it the ideal short stay hotel in Singapore.

These amenities cater to diverse guests' needs and ensure their stay is relaxing and hassle-free in this modern business hotel in Singapore.

Discover a preferred loft room hotel in Singapore for a stay like no other.

If staying active is a part of your routine, our indoor gym is available with an array of top-notch equipment. From cardio machines to strength training apparatus and free weights, we cater to every fitness enthusiast's needs.
