name: Ascott Orchard Singapore
tagline: Serviced Apartments in Orchard
description:
Experience sophisticated city living at Ascott Orchard Singapore, a premium serviced residence situated directly in the heart of Singapore's most fashionable shopping district. Our property offers an exclusive, smart living experience, ideally suited for international executives, discerning business travellers, and leisure guests seeking unparalleled comfort. You will find yourself just a few minutes' walk from both the Orchard and Somerset Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations, providing effortless and seamless access to the Central Business District, world-class luxury shopping malls, and leading medical facilities across Singapore. This prime position ensures immediate proximity to both commerce and curated leisure.

Ascott Orchard Singapore features 220 elegantly appointed suites, ranging from expansive studios to sophisticated two-bedroom units and exclusive top-floor residences. Every unit is designed to offer an elevated home away from home, featuring fully-equipped designer kitchens complete with a fridge, quality kitchenware, and a microwave, allowing for customised meal preparation at your leisure. For optimal residential convenience, our One-Bedroom and Two-Bedroom Suites are equipped with an in-suite laundry machine. Furthermore, professional laundry and dry cleaning services are available to all guests at an additional charge.

Your comfort and well-being remain our foremost priority. We offer a comprehensive range of facilities designed to enhance your stay: enjoy a refreshing dip in our outdoor swimming pool or relax in the Jacuzzi, both situated on the fourth floor. Maintain your essential fitness regime at our modern gymnasium, which features both air-conditioned and open-air sections, accessible 24 hours a day. For private meetings or quiet contemplation, our Residents' Lounge, complete with a fully-equipped kitchen, offers an inviting space for private dining or socialising. We also provide 24/7 on-call wellness and security support, including telehealth and non-emergency medical consultations, for complete peace of mind.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Ascott Orchard Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 20.71kg per night per room - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.
Water Footprint: 688.26 litres per night per room - performing above peer average in Singapore.

Location
Ascott Orchard Singapore boasts an exceptional and strategic location, placing our residents at the very heart of Singapore's most dynamic and fashionable district. Situated directly on Orchard Road, our serviced apartments offer unparalleled convenience for both business and leisure travellers. This prime position ensures immediate proximity to commerce and curated leisure: our property features direct, sheltered access via a convenient link bridge to the prestigious Paragon Shopping Mall. Key financial hubs, including the Central Business District, are swiftly accessible via excellent transport links, making commuting effortless for the executive resident.

The immediate neighbourhood is globally renowned as a premier retail and medical destination. Guests benefit from direct, sheltered access via a convenient link bridge to the prestigious Paragon Shopping Mall. Beyond shopping, our location provides crucial access to world-class medical facilities: Paragon Medical Centre is a mere 1-minute walk away, and Mount Elizabeth Hospital and Medical Centre is only a 3-minute walk from our doorstep, offering immediate reassurance and convenience. Exploring further afield is simple, with multiple MRT lines connecting you effortlessly to the iconic Gardens by the Bay, the historic Civic District, and other major attractions across the island.

Apartments
Ascott Orchard Singapore is linked to Paragon shopping mall through a covered bridge and is part of CapitaLand’s landmark integrated development that also comprises a high-end residential development. Ascott Orchard Singapore will have 220 suites comprising studios to two-bedroom units and top floor apartments.

Features: 

Complimentary wireless internet access (Wi-Fi)

Fully-equipped kitchen

Washing machine with dryer

Official room cards
Studio Executive Suite — 30 sqm.
A spacious suite of 30sqm in the layout of a studio apartment, offers the travelling executive an exclusive haven to recoup and rejuvenate after a day of meetings and business discussions. Elegantly fitted with stylish yet comfortable furniture in interiors befitting of a luxurious hotel.

Studio Premier Suite — 30 sqm.
This studio premier suite is well fitted and elegantly furnished. The soft muted tones used throughout the suite offers a sense of warmth and home to the business traveller on a short trip as well as elegance and luxury to the couple on a romantic getaway.

One-Bedroom Deluxe Suite — 60 sqm.
The perfect enclave for the busy executive here on extended business stay or relocation. Fully-furnished with carefully selected furniture, stylish accessories and a kitchen fully-equipped, making home cooking a breeze.

One-Bedroom Premier Suite — 60 sqm.
Located at the most fashionable address in Singapore, this one-bedroom suite with a generous floor area of 60sqm is elegantly furnished and equipped with the finest appliances and electronics. With interiors that resonates style, elegance and panache, this refined suite is the perfect home for the well-travelled business executive and partner, or a couple on leisure travel.

Two-Bedroom Premier Suite — 80 sqm.
Ideal for families, this spacious and luxuriously styled two-bedroom suite offers a home within the city. Fully-furnished with carefully selected furniture, timber floorings and floor to ceiling windows, this modern suite is the epitome of exclusivity.

Murano Suite — 30 sqm.
Elegantly designed top floor suite in studio apartment layout fitted with Fendi Casa furniture and accessories, sound bar and 40" Curved television. Ideal for couples on leisure travels or the business executive on a short business trip.

Pierre Suite — 60 sqm.
Luxuriate in this well-appointed one-bedroom top floor suite, that comes with a fully-equipped kitchen with De Dietrich brand of kitchen appliances. Feel pampered in a suite decked in Fendi Casa furniture and accessories that’s been carefully selected to make you feel at home.

Soho Suite — 80 sqm.
This spacious top floor suite is furnished with carefully selected furniture and accessories from Fendi Casa, elegant table and glassware by Christophe plus kitchen equipped with De Dietrich brand of kitchen appliances. This exquisite suite is suitable for a family of four here on relocation or for an extended stay. The Murano suite in studio apartment layout, connects to this elegant two-bedroom suite, making it suitable for visiting family or friends.

Facilities
The premium serviced residence is well suited for expatriates, business travellers and tourists as it is a few minutes’ walk from Orchard as well as Somerset Mass Rapid Transit stations with easy access to the Central Business District, world-class shopping malls and premium medical facilities.

Official named facilities
CHILDREN'S PLAYGROUND
Have family fun at the Outdoor Children's Playground

GYMNASIUM
Keep fit at any time of the day. This modern gym has 2 sections; choose to work out in cool air-con comforts indoors, or enjoy the gentle breeze of nature in the open-air section.

In view of updates to Safe Management Measures from 10 August 2021, residents will be allowed to use the gym (with capped capacity) if residents are fully vaccinated.

RESIDENTS' LOUNGE
Fitted with a fully-equipped kitchen, the Residents' Lounge is designed for residents to host private dining get-togethers with friends and associates. Rental charges apply, please approach Resident Services for assistance.

RESTAURANT
Start your day with a hearty breakfast and a good cup of coffee, located on the first floor.

SWIMMING POOL & JACUZZI
Relax in style at the outdoor pool and soak away the day's hustle and bustle.

24/7 ON-CALL WELLNESS & SECURITY
For greater comfort and reassurance during your stay, round-the-clock health, wellness and security support including telehealth or non-emergency medical consultation, updates on health and security situations within the property vicinity or the destination you are travelling to is available a call away. More info here.

FOR GUESTS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENTS
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with physical impairments. Accessible rooms are designed for comfort, and safety is prioritized with conveniently located accessible toilets featuring clear emergency instructions. Wheelchair ramps and lifts ensure smooth navigation throughout the property. Our staff are also trained to assist guests with disabilities, ensuring a comfortable and inclusive experience.

 

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

FOR GUESTS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENTS
The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with visual impairments, featuring braille signage in lifts to aid navigation. 

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

IN-ROOM INVENTORY LIST
Our space is impeccably appointed with carefully curated essentials and thoughtful details, creating a seamless and comfortable experience from the moment you arrive.

View the full list of items available in your room here.

name: Ascott Raffles Place Singapore
tagline: Luxury Serviced Apartments in Singapore
description:
Ascott Raffles Place Singapore offers an exceptional stay in the vibrant heart of Singapore’s Central Business District (CBD). This distinguished serviced residence is housed within a beautifully restored 1950s heritage structure, showcasing an elegant Art Deco façade that creates a striking contrast against the city’s contemporary skyline. Guests seeking a refined apartment in Singapore will find themselves perfectly positioned for both crucial business engagements and leisurely exploration, with immediate access to a dynamic array of cultural, entertainment, and sophisticated shopping destinations within the CBD and Marina Bay precinct.

Each spacious apartment offers a welcoming, refined sanctuary, featuring modern furnishings and thoughtful amenities for absolute comfort and convenience. Whether you choose a sophisticated studio or an expansive multi-bedroom suite, every detail ensures an elevated residential living experience. Guests benefit from complimentary high-speed wireless internet connectivity, a fully equipped designer kitchen for personalised meal preparation, and a premium BOSE home entertainment system for relaxation. This makes Ascott Raffles Place Singapore an ideal choice for discerning global travellers seeking sophisticated long-stay apartments in Singapore.

The property offers a comprehensive selection of facilities and signature services to enhance your stay. Guests can take a refreshing dip in the stunning infinity swimming pool overlooking the skyline, maintain their fitness routine in the well-appointed gymnasium, or find a quiet moment in The Living Room, our exclusive residents' lounge. For dining, CALI, our on-site restaurant, offers an exceptional all-day menu of Western cuisine, featuring dishes such as succulent braised beef cheeks and gourmet wagyu burgers. Engage with the Ascott Lifestyle through our curated residents' programmes, which focus on culture, gastronomy, and wellness, offering unique opportunities to connect with the city's rich tapestry.

Beyond the private comforts of your apartment, Ascott Raffles Place Singapore provides an array of bespoke services to cater to your every need. Benefit from 24/7 on-call wellness and security, ensuring peace of mind throughout your stay. Our dedicated team provides daily housekeeping services (excluding Sundays and public holidays), alongside convenient laundry and dry cleaning options. We are committed to ensuring comfort for all guests, offering accessible rooms and facilities for those with physical requirements. For those planning an extended visit, we provide a seamless blend of attentive service and residential comfort, ensuring every stay feels like an exceptional home.

Going Cashless
In order to enhance your guest experience, please note that the property will only be accepting the following payment methods: Credit card, debit card, secured online payment, mobile payment and electronic bank transfer.

Identity Verification Requirement

In accordance with the National Registration Regulations (Regulation 17), we kindly request that all guests present a valid physical ID or passport for identity verification upon entry.

Please note that other forms of identification, including work permit cards, foreign worker In-principle approval (IPA), driving licenses, and membership cards, will not be accepted.

Ascott Clean360
Ascott Raffles Place Singapore has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitment to safety, wellness and cleanliness. More info here.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 36.66 kg per room night - performing above peer average in Singapore. 
Water Footprint: 319.54 litres per room night - amongst top 25% peers in Singapore.

Location
Ascott Raffles Place Singapore enjoys an enviable, highly advantageous location in the vibrant heart of Singapore’s Central Business District (CBD). This lively neighbourhood seamlessly blends towering financial institutions with a rich tapestry of cultural landmarks, world-class dining, and exciting entertainment options. Our serviced apartments offer unparalleled access to everything Singapore has to offer, putting you just a short walk from your doorstep. Guests can take a stroll (approximately 5 minutes) to the famous Merlion Park, where one can capture memorable photographs with the city’s mythical mascot. The picturesque Singapore River is also nearby, inviting guests to enjoy a relaxing river cruise past historic Boat Quay and lively Clarke Quay.

Beyond the iconic sights, the immediate precinct offers premier retail and gastronomy. Food enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Lau Pa Sat (a renowned hawker centre offering authentic local cuisine), which is reachable within a brief walk. Additionally, premier shopping destinations like One Raffles Place and Raffles City Shopping Centre are within easy reach, offering extensive retail therapy and dining options. For panoramic city views, the magnificent Singapore Flyer is easily accessible and offers a truly unforgettable perspective of the skyline. This central location serves as the perfect base to experience the city's dynamic energy, whether your itinerary focuses on business or leisure.

Apartments
Step into our elegant residences and experience luxury and comfort on a different scale. Within your suite, enjoy the comforts of plush furnishings, tasteful decor and modern facilities. When you step outside, find yourself immediately immersed in one of Singapore’s most dynamic districts. 

All our suites are decorated with original artwork, modern kitchens, stylish dining rooms and even plusher sleeping areas.

Features:

Complimentary wireless internet access (WiFi)

Fully-equipped gymnasium

Washing machine with dryer

*Special Note: Ensuring the safety and comfort of our residents remains as our utmost priority. As such, we may refuse any reservations made for the purpose of group parties such as birthday or pre-wedding parties.

Official room cards
Studio Cutler Suite — 48 sqm.
Experience modern living with this contemporary studio apartment, which blends the perfect location with the ultimate stylish residence. The residence also comes with wireless Internet access, air-conditioning and daily housekeeping for your total convenience and comfort.

Apartment type comes in either Twin beds or 1 King-size bed.

One-Bedroom Collyer Suite — 52 sqm.
Whip up a home-cooked meal in the privacy and comfort of your residence, or unwind with a movie from our DVD library. Ideal for either short or long stays, the Collyer suite offers all the comforts of home with the conveniences of a hotel.

One-Bedroom Brown Suite — 75 sqm.
Whether you’re in Singapore for business or leisure, enjoy this plush, spacious suite that features elegant and comfortable living, dining and sleeping areas, and amenities such as wireless Internet access, air-conditioning and daily housekeeping services.

*Third person is chargeable.

One-Bedroom Finlayson Suite — 108 sqm.
Dressed in contemporary chic finishings, this spacious suite features stylishly appointed designer furnishings and fittings, large windows, a modern kitchen, and a large living and dining area.

*Third person is chargeable.

Two-Bedroom Malcolm Suite — 120 sqm.
Smartly configured to ensure both privacy and comfort, the 120 sqm suite is ideal for both short and long stays. Equipped with modern appliances and stylish furnishings, the apartment also features a private balcony that offers stunning city views.



*Fifth person is chargeable.

Two-Bedroom Elizabeth Suite — 148 sqm.
Enjoy the ultimate urban living experience with this two-bedroom suite, which brings together style, historic charm, and comfort to this upscale residence. The suite also comes with wireless Internet access, air-conditioning and daily housekeeping for your comfort and convenience.

*Fifth person is chargeable.

Facilities
At Ascott Raffles Place Singapore, we offer premium services and facilities to ensure a healthy body and healthy mind. Enjoy a hearty breakfast at the residence before embarking on your day, or reinvigorate the senses with a work out in the gymnasium. Parking facilities are available nearby the residence.

Official named facilities
Gymnasium
Enjoy a good workout session in our spacious gymnasium equipped with state-of-the-art equipment.

In view of updates to Safe Management Measures from 10 August 2021, residents will be allowed to use the gym (with capped capacity) if residents are fully vaccinated.

Infinity Swimming Pool
Take a dip in the cool waters of our infinity pool - the perfect way to refresh and unwind after a day in the office or after hours of exploration.

Restaurant
Enjoy modern Asian fusion cuisine at our bistro. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. In-room dining services are also available.

The Living Room

Official FAQ (property-page JSON-LD FAQPage)
What is the standard check-in and check-out time at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Check-in is from 3PM and Check-out is at 12PM. Early check-in and Late check-out request will be subjected to availability and may be chargeable.
Is there a check-in age restriction? The minimum age for check-in is 18 years old.
What payment methods are available at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Ascott Raffles Place Singapore accepts cash and credit cards (Amex, Visa, Mastercard, Unionpay).
Does Ascott Raffles Place Singapore offer facilities for guests with physical impairments? Yes, we are committed to providing an inclusive experience. We offer accessible rooms and our on-site restaurant, CALI, is wheelchair accessible. Our team is always ready to assist with any specific requirements to ensure a comfortable stay.
What types of apartments are available at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Ascott Raffles Place Singapore offers a range of spacious serviced apartments, including studios and multi-bedroom suites. Each is designed with modern furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen, and a BOSE home entertainment system for your comfort.
Is Ascott Raffles Place Singapore suitable for extended stays? Absolutely. Our spacious apartments, complete with fully equipped kitchens and comprehensive services like housekeeping and laundry, are ideally suited for extended stays. We aim to provide a comfortable, convenient home away from home for guests seeking long-stay apartments in Singapore.
Is there carpark available at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Unfortunately, we do not have a carpark available.
Is there any kids' facilities at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Unfortunately, we do not have any Kids' facilities at this moment.
Do you provide daily water bottles for long staying guest? No, Ascott Raffles Place Singapore does not provide replenishment of room amenties. Should you wish to enjoy daily replenishment of the room amenities (coffee/tea and bottled water), it is chargeable. You may contact the Front Office team for more information.
Are baby cots and extra bed available at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Yes, baby cots are available upon request but subjected to availability. Yes, extra bed is available upon request at additionaly charges, subjected to availability and can only be accomodated in certain room types.
Does Ascott Raffles Place Singapore provide airport shuttle service? Yes, we currently provide airport shuttle service. However, it is chargeable. Kindly reach out to find out more.
Are there dining options available at Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? Yes, CALI, our on-site restaurant, offers an all-day dining experience with a focus on exceptional Western cuisine. You can enjoy a variety of dishes, including braised beef cheeks, wagyu burgers, and grilled lobsters, in a chic and inviting atmosphere.
How close is Ascott Raffles Place Singapore to public transport? Our serviced residence is exceptionally well-connected. Raffles Place MRT Station, a major interchange for the East-West and North-South lines, is just a five-minute walk away. Telok Ayer MRT Station on the Downtown Line is also within a five-minute stroll.
What attractions are near Ascott Raffles Place Singapore? We are ideally situated near many of Singapore's iconic attractions. Merlion Park is a short walk away, and you can easily reach the Singapore River, Boat Quay, Clarke Quay, and the Singapore Flyer. The famous Lau Pa Sat hawker centre and major shopping malls are also within easy reach.

name: Fraser Suites Singapore
tagline: Enjoy lavish hotel amenities within a comforting home environment when you book a room at Fraser Suites Singapore.
description:
Experience Timeless Elegance at Fraser Suites Singapore

Live like a local at Fraser Suites Singapore – comprising 255 luxury apartments in Singapore’s upmarket River Valley residential enclave. With its proximity to the famed Orchard Road shopping belt and the buzzing nightlife scene at the three Quays – Clarke Quay, Boat Quay and Robertson Quay, residents can enjoy easy accessibility to the city centre within minutes, and the hottest dining and lifestyle destinations the Lion City is famous for.

Lavish Home Living
Fraser Suites Singapore is our multiple award-winning flagship serviced apartment in Singapore, and for good reason. Besides being in the prime residential neighbourhood of River Valley, our Gold Standard serviced apartments are beautifully designed and furnished, combining both the lavishness of a hotel and the comfort of home. They are equipped with all the modern conveniences to meet the high living standards of both leisure and business travellers, from fully-equipped kitchenettes to state-of-the-art security and entertainment systems. Larger apartments boast their own balcony as an added bonus. Pets are welcome, so you’ll feel at home when you choose Fraser Suites Singapore.

Children will have plenty to occupy themselves with our recreational facilities, whether in the wading pool or purpose-built Play Zone. Teach them where their food comes from in our very own Herb Garden, where a wide variety of herbs and spices are grown. Work up an appetite at the swimming pool or fully-fitted 24/7 gym, or sweat it out in the sauna and steam room before your friends come over to you for a barbecue. If you’d rather just stay in and dine, our resident chef will cook up your favourite dishes at The Dining Room restaurant or The Alfresco, where you can dig into Smoked Salmon & Egg Bagel and Mushroom Bruschetta a hearty brunch with your pooch by your side.

Whether you’re looking for luxury hotel apartments in Singapore for the short term or planning to stay longer to slowly absorb the local culture and lifestyle, Fraser Suites Singapore will make you feel right at home.

FLEXIBLE BOOKINGS. AWARD-WINNING. PET-FRIENDLY. GREAT LOCATION.

What type of beds are provided at Fraser Suites Singapore?
We provide King and Queen-sized beds across all types of rooms available at Fraser Suites Singapore.
The 1-Bedroom Deluxe and 1-Bedroom Premier apartments are each equipped with 1 King-sized bed.
The 2-Bedroom Deluxe apartment features 1 King-sized bed and 1 Queen-sized bed.
The 2-Bedroom Premier apartment has the option of 1 King-sized bed and 1 Queen-sized bed, or 1 King-sized bed and 2 Single beds.
The 3-Bedroom apartments feature 1 King-sized bed, 1 Queen-sized bed and 1 Single bed.
For information on bed types in our penthouses, kindly reach out to our team.

Are pets allowed at each Fraser Suites?
Yes, pets are allowed at Fraser Suites Singapore. Our pet-friendly serviced apartments welcome dogs and cats up to a certain size. Additional pet charges and terms and conditions apply. Please check with us when making your reservations.

What is the check-in and check-out time at Fraser Suites Singapore?
Check-in time is from 3pm and Check-out is at 12pm. This applies to suites booked for an extended stay and for a short term.

Is parking available at the property?
Each Fraser Suites is entitled to one parking space. Additional parking charges may apply. Kindly reach out to Guest Services for more details.

What attractions are located near Fraser Suites Singapore?
Fraser Suites Singapore is situated near Orchard Road, Marina Bay and the Central Business District, making it a convenient location for exploring these attractions as a visitor or making your way down for work. Additionally, the River Valley neighbourhood within which our property is located offers a lively atmosphere with a variety of cafes, pubs and restaurants for you to unwind at.

From 3 April 2025, Fraser Suites Singapore is thrilled to announce our commitment to sustainability: for every booking made via our official website or direct channels, we will plant a tree in collaboration with EcoMatcher, a Certified B Corporation.

THE GOLD STANDARD IN LUXURY SERVICED APARTMENTS
Fraser Suites Singapore offers luxury accommodation in Singapore’s upmarket River Valley district which is popular with both locals and expatriates.

Its open-plan Gold Standard furnished apartments in Singapore feature stylish interiors, fully-equipped kitchenette, the latest security and entertainment systems, high-speed Wi-Fi and seamless connectivity, making us the top choice for business and leisure travellers.

The 255 luxury furnished apartments in Singapore come in One-, Two- and Three-bedroom layouts, as well as the ultra-luxury penthouse suites. Besides luxury accommodation in Singapore, the residences offer exclusive features such as an open concept bathroom in each one-bedroom apartment and private balconies in the larger three-bedroom suites. The 3-bedroom penthouses offer sprawling living spaces as well as breezy terraces for enjoying morning coffee. Big enough for 6 to 8 people, the penthouses are the epitome of sophisticated living in the Garden City.

Recreational facilities for the entire family
Planning to stay in a Singapore serviced apartment for the long term? Fraser Suites Singapore city apartments will take care of all your needs. A full range of facilities are designed with your active lifestyle in mind.

City guide (official) — About River Valley
Located in central Singapore, River Valley is a vibrant neighbourhood laced with trendy cafes, pubs and restaurants, yet retaining a distinctive relaxed vibe, despite being in close proximity to Orchard Road, CBD and Marina Bay.

Around Us & Beyond
EAT & DRINK
AMOY STREET FOOD CENTRE (10-min drive) Amoy Street Food Centre is one of the busiest and most popular food centres amongst the locals. It also houses the greatest number of Michelin-listed stalls, spanning from decades-old stalls to budding stalls started by enterprising youngsters. Located in the CBD translates to lunch-time madness on weekdays during the lunch hour. So come outside of a weekday lunch timing, and on weekends, no later than noon on Saturdays, and to expect only half of the stalls to be operating.
BISTECCA TUSCAN STEAKHOUSE (6-min drive) Being conferred on the title of being the 13th best steakhouse in the world, this restaurant is humbly set in a lovely old shophouse along Mohammed Sultan Road, which is just a six-minute drive away.
FIVE STAR (6-min drive) If there’s anything homier and comforting, it has to be chicken rice. and Five Star makes one of the most authentic in town, using flavourful kampung chickens, served with their homemade chilli and ginger sauces.
MOBOMAGA (10-min drive) For sake lovers, this hidden izakay offers delicious Japanese cuisine and an excellent selection of sake, including some of the rarest sakes.

ATTRACTIONS & ACTIVITIES
CHINATOWN (10-min drive) Chinatown is among the Lion City’s most atmospheric areas. Known for its colourful heritage buildings, hiding old Chinese shophouses, it is not surprising that there is plenty to discover in Chinatown.
NATIONAL GALLERY OF SINGAPORE (10-min drive) Home to over 1,000 art works, the National Gallery Singapore is housed within the iconic restored Supreme Court and City Hall buildings.
ORCHARD ROAD (6-min drive) Ready, get set, shop! This iconic retail street is over 2.5km, lined with glitzy malls that house world-famous brands. Time to get your retail therapy!

OUTDOORS
SINGAPORE BOTANIC GARDENS (6-min drive) Inscribed as Singapore’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2015, this national park is worth setting aside half a day for!

FRASER INSIDER
LAST KAMPUNG – KAMPONG LORONG BUANGKOK Within the greater Seletar neighbourhood, you can find the last kampung standing on mainland Singapore, Kampong Lorong Buangkok. Take a walk through the small village and get transported back in time. Do seek permission from the residents before entering the houses.
A "Do You Know?" moment. Experience the destination like a local.

BEYOND THE NEIGHBOURHOOD
BUGIS STREET Experience street shopping at Bugis Street, one of the best shopping places offering the latest trends at affordable prices. Bugis Street is also a haven for food lovers, offering a wide array of mouth-watering delicacies. The gastronomical experience never fails to enhance the entire experience at Bugis Street.
HAJI LANE Haji lane is a narrow street around the corner of Bugis street and is a hidden gem. A colourful street which is lined on both sides by boutiques, cafes, bars and eateries and the best part is that all of them are decorated with painted murals in various hues. You will find the best of restaurants offering some local and innovative delectables. The shops are all filled with unique gift items, accessories and the latest fashion clothing along with shoes, bags, and purses. This place will just fill your heart with delight with its cool and hip ambiance. A walk down Haji lane is a must on your trip to Bugis Street in Singapore.
PULAU UBIN Get off the mainland and head to this charming island to bask in the rustic outdoors and explore one of Singapore’s last remaining villages or kampongs. Either take a 15-minute car ride or a 40-minute journey by bus to Changi Point Ferry Terminal. From there, board a bumboat to the island.
THE SOUTHERN RIDGES Hike above the city, a ten-kilometre network of ridges, pathways and bridges elevated above the city skyline. The hiking route is a favourite haunt of avid birdwatchers and nature lovers, and visitors can expect to see up to 43 species of birds.

tagline: Revel in Award-Winning Living With Fraser Residence Orchard
description:
Revel in Award-Winning Living With Fraser Residence Orchard

When work or play brings you to the dynamic cosmopolitan city of Singapore, set up home in the award-winning premises of Fraser Residence Orchard – named the World’s Leading Serviced Apartment by World Travel Awards 2020. Step into your own ‘garden in the city’ of lush landscaped surroundings surrounding our contemporary Singapore residences for rent that are a peaceful retreat from bustling Orchard Road just steps away.

Luxury Suites in a Lavish Location

With easy proximity to the bright lights of Singapore’s shopping and nightlife scene, its fast-paced financial centre and world-class medical institutions, Fraser Residence Orchard serviced apartments offer an unbeatable location. You’ll want to stay in our suites for as long as possible.

With sleek lines, contemporary architecture and understated interiors, the 115 fully-furnished serviced apartments in the Orchard district offer a visual respite after a long day out on the town.

Recharge your body and soul, with a wide range of facilities and services designed to appeal to the whole family. Outdoor swimming pools provide an upscale resort feel for lounging or for swimming laps, while an aqua gym and 24-hour fully-equipped gym are available for the fitness-minded. A steam and sauna room, a children’s playground, BBQ facilities and a lovely alfresco sky terrace complete the lifestyle experience.

Getting around town from our suites couldn’t be easier, as the glittery ION Orchard mall and the Orchard MRT station are only a five-minute stroll away, with a whole stretch of world-class department stores, restaurants, cinemas and food courts on either side. Mount Elizabeth Hospital, one of the top medical facilities in Singapore, is also within easy walking distance. From Orchard MRT station, arrive at the financial district at City Hall and Raffles City in under five minutes, or to any of the city’s leisure attractions, including the iconic Singapore River.

When you come home to Fraser Residence Orchard’s studio, one- and two-bedroom serviced apartments, you’re assured of Gold Standard service and a memorable stay, whether it’s for the short or long-term.

Is parking available at the property?

Yes, we have an onsite car park at Fraser Residence Orchard and parking is complimentary for one vehicle per suite. Kindly reach out to Guest Services for more details.

Is there an airport shuttle service to and fro Fraser Residence Orchard?

Unfortunately, an airport shuttle service is not available between Singapore Changi Airport and Fraser Residence Orchard. However, a limousine service or taxi can be arranged upon request. Please feel free to approach Guest Services for more details.

What is the cost of the limousine service?

For the arrangement of transport and pricing details, please approach the guest services or contact us at reservations.singapore@frasershospitality.com or +65 62 700 800.

Is internet access provided in Fraser residences?

Yes, guests of Fraser residences here in Orchard can enjoy complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi access in our serviced apartments and around the property.

What Singapore attractions are located near Fraser Residence Orchard?

Fraser Residence Orchard is located in the much-coveted Orchard area of Singapore, offering guests access to a wealth of experiences such as country clubs and a 10-minute drive to the central business district. The Istana, which is the official residence and office of the President of Singapore, is also located along Orchard Road, not too far away from our residences. Official FAQ

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Is the property pet-friendly?

Yes, you may bring up to two pets with you during your stay. However, please note that pets are not permitted in our Studio apartments.

Additional charges and other terms and conditions apply should you wish to bring along your pet. Please check with the property when making the reservations.

What are the operating hours for Guest Services?

The reception desk is available 24/7.

What is your cancellation policy?

Our cancellation policy is determined by the terms of the offer selected.

Should you require more information, please feel free to contact us at reservations.singapore@frasershospitality.com or +65 62 700 800

What type of beds are provided?

Studio and one-bedroom apartments feature one king bed, while two-bedroom apartments offer a selection of king, queen and single beds.

Hollywood Twin beds are available for selected Studio and one-bedroom apartments.

Is internet access provided in Fraser residences?

Yes, guests of Fraser residences here in Orchard can enjoy complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi access in our serviced apartments and around the property.

What time is check-in and check-out?

Check-in time is from 3pm and Check-out is at 12pm.

Are newspapers provided?

The Straits Times, Business Times, Lianhe Zaobao, International Herald Tribune, Asian Wall Street Journal, Asahi Shimbun and Nikkei Shimbun are available for in-room subscription, with applicable charges

How do I get to Fraser Residence Orchard, Singapore?

The property is easily accessible from Changi International Airport via car, taxi, train or bus.

What are the available dining options?

City guide (official)

From luxury retail to world-class international cuisines, the much-coveted Orchard area is home to a wealth of experiences.

There is more to this former plantation area than just retail glamour and enchantment, with top local and international schools, country clubs, and being just a 10-minute drive to the CBD. The Istana - official residence and office of the President of Singapore sits along Orchard Road too.

Read MoreRead Less

Around Us & Beyond

EAT & DRINK

MERCI MARCEL ORCHARD(6-min drive)
A Parisian café inspired, situated in the greener corner of Singapore’s shopping district with hints of Bauhaus architecture, and tropical motifs. Vibrant, citrus-toned walls lined with lush greenery. Offerings vary from gourmet food, unique drinks and (many) Instagrammable spots.

PISTACHIO MIDDLE EASTERN & MEDITERRANEAN GRILL (3-min drive)
A halal restaurant that offers popular classic Middle Eastern and Mediterranean dishes with a contemporary twist for lunch and dinner.

KILLINEY ROAD FOOD TRAIL(15-min drive)

On the fringe of Orchard Road sits Killiney Road - a narrow road which is colourful and busy. Start off your day with local breakfast at the famous the famous Killiney Kopitiam, at o. 67. Right next to it is Warung M Nasir, one of the best places in the city to enjoy a tantalising collection of authentic Padang-style dishes. Trot a few units down the road to this casual Cantonese-style restaurant for perfectly charred char siew and melt-in-your-mouth fatty roast pork, the very reason why they have become a mainstay along Killiney Road.

LITTLE INDIA(10-min drive)
Little India is a buzzing historic area that shows off the best of Singapore’s Indian community, from vibrant culture to incredible shopping. Walking down the streets itself is a sensory experience – brightly-coloured saris, incense, spices and Indian pop music swirl around along with street stalls selling tempting delicacies. Definitely one of the most charismatic neighbourhood in Singapore.

WILD HONEY(15-min walk)
Just off the tip of Orchard Road, Wild Honey provides a calm respite from the busy shopping crowds.. The spacious and modern restaurant offers delectable favourites, with a choice between indoor and al fresco dining.

ATTRACTIONS & ACTIVITIES

EMERALD HILL ROAD (7-min drive)

Colourful terrace houses in the Chinese Baroque style line this road in the conservation area between Newton and Orchard Road. This was once a nutmeg plantation owned by William Cuppage until his death in 1872, after which it was subdivided. Wealthy Peranakans snapped up the land and made it their home, building these beautiful houses. Over the years, they have been meticulously restored and maintained.

NATIONAL MUSEUM OF SINGAPORE (7-min drive)

One of the oldest and largest museum in Singapore, the original domed building, designed by colonial engineer Henry E. McCallum in a neo-Palladian style, has been a local landmark since 1887. A sizable chunk of the collection is devoted to the history of Singapore and tracing the country’s evolution from British crown colony to independent nation.

TIONG BAHRU (10-min drive)

Located in one of Singapore’s oldest residential estates, Tiong Bahru has become synonymous with trendy cafes, quirky boutiques, unique architecture, mural art and good old-fashioned foods! Whether a history buff, a foodie or a shopaholic, there is something for everyone to discover in Tiong Bahru.

OUTDOORS

SINGAPORE BOTANIC GARDENS (8-min drive)

Inscribed as Singapore’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2015, this national park is worth setting aside half a day for!

SINGAPORE RIVER CRUISE / MERLION PARK (10-min drive)

Get ready to set sail on a traditional bumboat and drift along the Singapore River, taking in the sights of famous landmarks such as Raffles' Landing Site, the Merlion, ArtSceince Museum, Singapore flyer and Marina Bay Sands. Hop aboard in the late afternoon or early evening to catch the sunset, for that added bonus.

FRASER INSIDER

ADAM ROAD FOOD CENTRE
Small in stature but quite a giant in Singapore’s dining scene. Adam Road Food Centre offers hawker gems that is popular amongst the locals. Built in 1974 to house the street hawkers plying their trade along Bukit Timah Canal, Adam Road Food Centre was quickly known as a place for great Malay food, a recognition that continues up to today. Did not take long before other stalls also drew up their share of long queues too.

Fun fact: The Nasi Lemak stall Selera Rasa was reportedly a breakfast staple for the Sultan of Brunei whenever he visits.

A "Do You Know?" moment. Experience the destination like a local.

BEYOND THE NEIGHBOURHOOD

PULAU UBIN

Get off the mainland and head to this charming island to bask in the rustic outdoors and explore one of Singapore’s last remaining villages or kampongs. Take a 30-minute car ride to Changi Point Ferry Terminal, and board a bumboat to the island.

SUNGEI BULOH WETLAND RESERVE
This sanctuary, an ASEAN Heritage Park, is as wild as it gets in manicured Singapore. The 500 acres of land is made up of mangroves, mudflats, ponds, and forests that are home to a biodiverse ecosystem of mudskippers, crabs, water snakes, monitor lizards, otters, and the odd crocodile. The trails are quite flat and is fairly easy to navigate.

THE SOUTHERN RIDGES

Hike above the city, a ten-kilometre network of ridges, pathways and bridges elevated above the city skyline. The hiking route is a favourite haunt of avid birdwatchers and nature lovers, and visitors can expect to see up to 43 species of birds.

description:
Capri by Fraser, China Square: Design-Led Living in Chinatown Hotel Singapore

The soul of Singapore’s CBD is reinterpreted in a vibrant, modern aesthetic at Capri by Fraser, China Square - where heritage meets cosmopolitan in a delightfully refreshing way.

As soon as you step into the lobby of our centrally located Chinatown hotel, you’ll be captivated by the stunning watercolour backdrop that sets the design tone. Depicting the city’s iconic conservation shophouses, this is just one of the many Singaporean and Southeast Asian heritage motifs and illustrations that can be found throughout our chic serviced residence, creating a vibrant and modern aesthetic that perfectly blends heritage and cosmopolitanism.

Surrounded by Singapore’s hottest restaurants, steps away from the financial district, and within walking distance of four MRT stations - Chinatown, Telok Ayer, Maxwell, and Raffles Place, Capri by Fraser, China Square is a hotel in Chinatown Singapore, reinventing the concept of social living in the most talked-about destination in town.

FULLY FURNISHED APARTMENTS

Located near Chinatown Point, Capri by Fraser, China Square is designed for urban, tech-savvy travellers who appreciate creative spaces and social experiences. Standing at 16 storeys tall, it offers a refreshing approach to hospitality, featuring 304 smartly appointed rooms and co-living facilities that provide the perfect canvas for creating new stories and nurturing friendships. Our Chinatown hotel in Singapore is at the forefront of hotel technology, ensuring you have the best possible experience during your stay.

Besides contemporary interiors with charming heritage-inspired design details, the Deluxe, Premier, Executive and Studio accommodations are also furnished with modern appliances and cooking facilities. The eco-friendly property includes sustainable features such as in-room smart controls and a premium filtered drinking water tap.

GREAT LOCATION

Capri by Fraser, China Square is uniquely positioned as a top luxury hotel in Chinatown Singapore, where old-world temples and mosques meet new-world high finance and MNCs. Indulge in the culinary delights of nearby Telok Ayer and Amoy Streets, and explore the hidden treasures of Smith, Temple, Pagoda, and Mosque Streets.

If you're looking to explore beyond our nearest location in Chinatown, stroll to the nearby MRT stations, and discover Singapore's renowned Orchard Road shopping district, as well as a plethora of leisure and dining attractions that are only minutes away. Whether you're here for business or leisure, Capri by Fraser, China Square offers a unique lifestyle experience that captures the vibrancy of our little red dot.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What time is breakfast served?

Breakfast is served from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM at Moss Cross Tokyo, Singapore (Level 2).

What are the available dining options?

Moss Cross Tokyo, Singapore is a modern restaurant located on Level 2. It combines Japanese elegance with French sophistication. The hotel restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, as well as an in-room dining option for guests who prefer to dine in their rooms.

Ready-to-eat meals are also available from 10 PM to 6 AM. Please feel free to contact the Front Desk via the Digital Concierge for more details.

Is it possible to store my luggage at the hotel before check-in?

Yes, you may store your luggage with us before check-in. Please feel free to approach the Concierge at level 1 for assistance.

Does the hotel offer on-site parking, and what is the cost?

On-site parking is available at Capri by Fraser, China Square. Please view the parking rates at www.crossstreetexchange.com.sg/getting-here-by-car or approach the Front Desk for more details.

What are the prohibited items?

For the safety and comfort of all guests, illegal substances, weapons, flammable or hazardous materials, and any items that may cause disturbance or damage are prohibited on the premises. Items that exude strong smells, such as Durians, are also prohibited.

Where can I find the nearest bank, ATM, or currency exchange near Capri by Fraser, China Square?

Nearest bank: DBS South Bridge Branch at Blk 531 Upper Cross Street, #01-51, Hong Lim Complex

Nearest ATM: Located at 137 Amoy Street

Currency exchange: A self-service exchange machine is available within the hotel, located in front of The Den on Level 2.

Please feel free to approach our Front Desk for directions or more details.

Are laundry services provided?

Yes. Laundry, dry-cleaning, and pressing services are available, subject to additional charges. There are also washers and dryers available in our Spin & Play room located on level 16 for your convenience. Charges apply. Please feel free to contact our Front Desk via the Digital Concierge for more details.

Can I use the hotel’s facilities to freshen up if I arrive early or have a late flight?

Yes. Guests with bookings at Capri by Fraser, China Square enjoy complimentary access to our private shower facilities on level 15. Facilities include secure lockers, plush towels, and premium bath amenities. Please feel free to approach the Front Desk for assistance.

Are airport transfers available to Capri by Fraser, China Square?

Airport transfers to Capri by Fraser, China Square can be arranged through our Reservation Team. Please feel free to contact us at resvn.chinasquare@capribyfraser.com or call us at +65 6437 0800. Charges apply.

Are newspapers provided?

Newspapers are not provided, but you can stay updated with the latest news via the in-room TV news channels.

Are the residences disabled-friendly?

Yes, the property is disabled-friendly.

Are there fitness facilities provided?

Yes, there is a 24/7 fully-equipped gym and a rooftop swimming pool located at level 16.

What is the check-in and check-out timing at Capri by Fraser, China Square?

Hotel check-in starts from 3:00 PM, and check-out is at 12:00 PM.

What type of beds are provided?

All room categories at Capri by Fraser, China Square feature a King-sized bed. Hollywood twin bed options are available in the Deluxe and Premier room categories only.

How do I get to the hotel?

Capri by Fraser, China Square is easy to reach from Changi International Airport via the public train in approximately 50 minutes. You may also get to the hotel via taxi in approximately 25 minutes, depending on traffic.

Are pets allowed?

Unfortunately, pets are not allowed on the premises.

What is the maximum number of guests allowed in each room category?

Maximum occupancy is three guests, which includes two adults and one child. Children aged 0 to 5 years stay free when sharing an existing bed. Children aged 6 to 12 years may also share an existing bed at no extra charge. For added comfort, an extra bed can be requested, subject to availability, at an additional cost.

For any further assistance or inquiries, please feel free to contact us at resvn.chinasquare@capribyfraser.com or call us at +65 6437 0800.

What are the services and facilities offered?

Guests have access to a full range of services and facilities, including a fully-equipped gym, rooftop swimming pool, The Den (social hub) and more. Click here for a complete list of services and facilities.

Are baby cots and extra beds available?

Yes, baby cots are available on a complimentary basis and subject to availability.

Welcome to Oasia Residence, Singapore. Your wellness journey begins here.

Oasia Residence, Singapore, a four-time HRM Asia Readers’ Choice Award winner, offers a tranquil, wellness-focused serviced residence in the West Coast. Situated near Singapore's science and technology hub, including NUS and Singapore Science Park, we cater to discerning business travelers seeking restorative stays. Our pet-friendly residence features 140 studios to two-bedroom apartments, designed to help you Experience Wellness, and we welcome guests for both short weekly stays and extended periods.

Embrace our Refresh, Refuel, and Recharge wellness pillars, enjoying scenic West Coast Park strolls, daily continental breakfast, and access to a fitness center, tennis court, and pools. We prioritize your well-being, offering a restorative urban respite. Your journey to wellness begins at Oasia Residence, Singapore.

Our apartments

Studio

Welcome to Village Residence Robertson Quay. Experience city living by the river.

Official homepage gallery captions
Take in the stunning riverside view from your balcony, a serene spot for morning coffee and relaxation.
Comfort meets style in this inviting bedroom.
Bright, open living space perfect for both work and leisure.
Rest easy in our comfortable bedroom.
A comfortable sleeping space for your little ones.
Fire up the grill and enjoy fun moments with friends or loved ones.
A vibrant play area for children to laugh and explore.
From cardio to strength training, everything you need is here for a great workout.

Vicinity Redevelopment Works
Please be informed that a major redevelopment project is ongoing next to our serviced residence from 1 June 2025 to end 2028.
During this period, guests can expect to experience construction-related noise and disruption.
We sincerely appreciate your understanding and patience.

Village Residence Robertson Quay, a preferred choice for expatriates and recognised with the Gold 'Best Serviced Apartment' award, offers an exceptional riverside living experience. Situated along the scenic Singapore River, our residence is immersed in a dynamic neighborhood filled with alfresco dining, lively bars, art galleries, and diverse shopping options. Its proximity to the Central Business District and Singapore's efficient transport network ensures effortless city connectivity.

We offer both short weekly stays and extended periods in our 71 pet-friendly apartments, ranging from studios to spacious 3-bedroom layouts, all designed for modern comfort.

Guests and their furry companions can enjoy leisurely walks or jogs along the picturesque Singapore River. A short stroll leads to the historic charm of Chinatown, offering cultural immersion. Experience Singapore like a local, blending the city's rich traditions with its contemporary lifestyle, at Village Residence Robertson Quay.

Kindly note that all Studio apartments & some Two-Bedroom Apartments are walk up apartments.

What payment methods are accepted by the property? For a seamless transaction, cash and cheque will no longer be accepted at all our hotels and serviced residences in Singapore. Which popular attractions are close to your Serviced Residence? Nearby attractions include Orchard Central (5-min walk), Istana Park (5-min walk) and Fort Canning Park (10-min walk).
What are the check-in requirements for guests? In accordance with the National Registration Regulations, guests must be at least 18 years of age to check-in. A valid physical identification (passport or NRIC) is required at registration. Driver’s licenses, membership cards, and Singpass will not be accepted.
Are pets allowed? Pets are allowed at our Serviced Residence levied at SGD 30 per day or SGD 500 per month, subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax.
Do I need to pay a deposit for the residence during my stay? A deposit is generally not required for stays less than three months at our Serviced Residences. If the stay is between three months and one year, we will be collecting a one-month deposit. If the stay is more than one year, we will be collecting a two-month deposit.
Do you have a washer and dryer? In-room washer and dryer are available at our Serviced Residences.
Do you have parking facilities? On-site parking is available for guests, subject to prevailing parking rates and availability.
Do you have a smoking area at the residence? Smoking is allowed in our apartments.
Do you provide baby cots or high chairs? Baby cots and high chairs are available and are subjected to availability.
Do you provide airport transfers? Airport transfer to and from our Serviced Residences can be arranged at a charge of SGD 100 per transfer, subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax. Other standard surcharges apply (subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax), chargeable to the guest.
Do you provide laundry services? Laundry services are available daily except Sunday and Public Holidays. Dry cleaning and other laundry service are available, you may also refer to the in-room laundry list for charges or approach our Guest Service Executives for more information.
How many occupants are permitted in each residence? Studio – 2 Adults Two-Bedroom Apartment – 4 Adults Three-Bedroom Apartment – 6 Adults. Children are defined as guests aged 6 years and below. Guest’s request for extra beds during their stay is subject to availability and apartment type. Is there luggage-storing facility? Storage of luggage is unavailable at our Serviced Residences.
What is the housekeeping schedule of the residences? Housekeeping service is provided according to the contractual terms for each apartment on stipulated days and time except on Sundays and Public Holidays.

What payment methods are accepted by the property? For a seamless transaction, cash and cheque will no longer be accepted at all our hotels and serviced residences in Singapore. What are the check-in requirements for guests? In accordance with the National Registration Regulations, guests must be at least 18 years of age to check-in. Are pets allowed? Pets are allowed at our Serviced Residence levied at SGD 30 per day or SGD 500 per month, subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax.

Serviced Suites Policy

Back to The Serviced Suites

Check-in & Check-out

Guests must be at least 21 years of age to register and check in to a suite. Check-in time is from 3:00 PM, while check-out time is by 11:00 AM.

Guest Identity Verification Requirement at Check-InIn line with Regulation 17 of the National Registration Regulations (NRR), guests must present a valid physical Identity Card (IC) or Passport for verification during check-in. Digital NRICs (e.g., via Singpass) and other IDs such as work permits, In-Principle Approval (IPA) letters, driving licences, and membership cards are not accepted. Only original physical ICs or passports are permitted for identity verification. For further clarification, please contact us at +65 6296 2511 or email to enquiry.prssin@parkroyalhotels.com.

Rates Policy

Rates are subject to prevailing Goods and Services Tax (GST).

Child Policy

A maximum of one child under the age of six years old is allowed to share the room without additional charges using existing bedding.

Rollaway Beds

Rollaway beds are available upon request for selected suite categories, subject to availability and suite layout configuration. A charge of SGD80+ per suite per night applies, subject to prevailing Goods and Services Tax (GST). Rates are subject to revision without prior notice.

Baby Cot/Crib Hire

Complimentary upon request (subject to availability).

In-Room DiningGuests may also enjoy in-room dining services provided by PARKROYAL on Beach Road by dialling "6" to place an order. Prices are subject to prevailing Goods and Services Tax (GST) and may be revised without prior notice.

Airport Shuttle

Please contact our Guest Services Ambassadors to arrange for limousine service.

Parking Fee

Complimentary parking is available for all monthly stay residents.

Valet Parking

Valet parking service is not available.

Payment Types

The Serviced Suites accepts Visa, Master, American Express, JCB, Diners, and Union Pay. Please present the same credit card used to guarantee your booking when checking in or making payment upon your arrival.

Accessibility

The PARKROYAL Serviced suites are wheelchair-accessible; however there is no dedicated wheelchair-friendly or elderly-friendly room categories. Guests with specific accessibility requirements are encouraged to contact the property prior to their stay for assistance and recommendations.

Wheelchair-accessible rooms are available at selected sister properties under Pan Pacific Hotels Group. For more information and availability, please visit Pan Pacific Hotels Group

Smoking Rooms

The Serviced Suites maintain a strict no-smoking policy within its public areas and suites. A cleaning fee of SGD 300 per suite per incident will apply for any violation of this policy. Please speak with our team for the designated smoking area.

With a view that stretches more than 40 kilometres all the way to the shores of Malaysia and Indonesia, a trip on the Singapore Flyer is a memorable way to take in the spectacular sights of Singapore and beyond.

Our Commitment to Sustainability

At PARKROYAL Serviced Suites, Singapore, we are committed to promoting sustainability across all aspects of our operations. Our dedication to creating a greener future is reflected in our practices and initiatives, which are designed to minimise our environmental impact while enriching our community and cultural landscape.

Achievements & Certifications

As part of our ongoing commitment to globalise our green efforts, Pan Pacific Hotels Group has achieved the prestigious Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC) Multi-Site Certification for all eight of its properties in Singapore. This significant achievement highlights our dedication to sustainability. Our ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications further emphasis our commitment to environmental management and occupational health and safety. These achievements align with our broader sustainability goals and reflect our dedication to creating an exceptional, responsible hospitality experience for our guests.

Our Environment

Each suite features a wooden cube that highlights our green initiatives, including filtered water taps that eliminate the need for disposable plastic bottles and in-room recycling bins to promote responsible waste management.We have also transitioned from single-use miniature toiletries to Appelles refillable dispenser bottles, significantly reducing plastic waste. Appelles amenities are eco-friendly and vegan, free from parabens and MIT*, and never tested on animals.To conserve energy, we encourage towel reuse and have pre-set all air-conditioning units at 24°C. In addition, we have upgraded to Variable Refrigerant Volume (VRV) air-conditioning systems, delivering up to 20% energy savings — equivalent to more than $94,000 annually.For guests who wish to explore Singapore sustainably, we offer complimentary bicycle rentals to discover the city in an eco-friendly way.These initiatives reflect our ongoing commitment to reducing our environmental footprint and fostering a greener, more sustainable future for our community and guests.

Our People & Community

At PARKROYAL Serviced Suites Singapore, we are committed to making a meaningful impact through initiatives that foster engagement, education, and local support.

In May 2025, together with Pan Pacific Serviced Suites Beach Road and Pan Pacific Serviced Suites Orchard, we partnered with All Kin Senior Aging Centre to spend an afternoon with the elderly. The programme included lunch, games, and a painting workshop, along with the donation of 50 grocery bags and supermarket vouchers.

In Nov 2025, Our serviced suites organised an outing with Brighton Connections Singapore for primary school children from low-income households, where they explored Gardens by the Bay through a scavenger hunt, nature activities, and simple team challenges to build on confidence and teamwork. Each child took home a customised school bag and water bottle, providing both encouragement and practical support as they prepare for the new year.

Earlier, on 22 November 2024, the Cluster Singapore Serviced Suites also hosted a year-end celebration for Children Wishing Well. The event brought joy to 30 children through a creative art jamming workshop, a catered buffet lunch, a magic show, mini games, and goodie bags, creating a truly memorable experience.Beyond charitable outreach, we also nurture connections with our residents through community activities such as Halloween Night, Valentine’s Day, and Sunset Yoga—building a sense of belonging within our property. Through these initiatives, we aim to strengthen community ties and create a positive, lasting impact for those around us.

Our Art, Culture & Heritage

We strive to enrich our guests’ experiences by celebrating Singapore’s vibrant arts, culture, and heritage. We actively support local and inclusive art communities by commissioning and showcasing diverse artworks, providing exposure for both emerging local artists and those with disabilities. This includes the painting, Fountain, 1996, by renowned Singapore Cultural Medallion recipient, Chua Ek Kay, which is showcased in lobby area.

In collaboration with Pan Pacific Serviced Suites Beach Road Singapore, we also host a weekly Cultural Heritage Tour, where residents embark on a one-hour immersive journey through Kampong Glam, discovering the rich history and traditions of this iconic district.Through these experiences, we invite our guests to connect with the heart and soul of Singapore.

Catch the sun in the airy garden courtyard, marvel at the traditionally-styled architectural façade, or just let your feet take you to the sounds, sights and tastes of one of Asia’s busiest shopping clusters, Orchard Road. And with an MRT exit just a stone’s throw away, Lanson Place Winsland blends urban-centre convenience, tranquillity, and signature home comforts in one of the most sought-after options for a serviced apartment in Singapore, Asia’s most liveable city.

Serviced Apartments | Lanson Place Winsland Singapore

Discover the Lanson Place Winsland Singapore serviced apartments. We offer rooms and suites perfect for your next stay in a prime location, near Somerset MRT.

Service Apartment Singapore: The Ideal Choice for Modern Living

In the vibrant city of Singapore, service apartments have emerged as a popular choice for both expatriates and tourists seeking comfortable, flexible living arrangements. These accommodations blend the comfort of home with the conveniences of hotel services, making them an attractive option for various travelers. Whether you’re relocating for work, enjoying a family vacation, or simply exploring the city, a service apartment Singapore can provide you with the ideal living experience.

A service apartment Singapore is a fully furnished residential unit that offers hotel-like amenities and services. These apartments typically include essential furnishings, kitchen facilities, and access to housekeeping and concierge services. Designed to cater to the needs of long-term guests, service apartments Singapore provide ample space and privacy for individuals or families. This unique combination makes them an appealing alternative to traditional hotels or rental properties.

Opting for a service apartment Singapore comes with numerous advantages. One of the most significant benefits is the flexibility in lease terms; whether you need a short-term stay or a long-term residence, these apartments can accommodate your needs without the constraints of lengthy contracts. Additionally, service apartments Singapore are often located in prime areas close to public transportation and major attractions, ensuring easy access to everything Singapore has to offer. This convenience makes them particularly appealing for business travelers and tourists alike.

Singapore boasts a diverse range of service apartments Singapore, catering to various budgets and preferences. Luxury options provide high-end amenities such as swimming pools and fitness centers, while mid-range choices offer comfort without excessive costs. For those on tighter budgets, there are also affordable service apartments Singapore that maintain quality while providing essential services. This variety ensures that everyone can find suitable accommodations that meet their needs.

When searching for a service apartment Singapore, location is crucial. Areas like the Central Business District (CBD) are ideal for professionals needing proximity to their workplaces. For those interested in shopping and entertainment, Orchard Road is home to numerous serviced apartments that offer easy access to malls and dining options. Additionally, neighborhoods like Marina Bay provide stunning views and quick access to iconic attractions, making them perfect for tourists.

Choosing the right service apartment Singapore involves several key considerations that can significantly enhance your living experience. Here are some essential factors to keep in mind:

When selecting a service apartment Singapore, price is often a primary concern. The cost of service apartments in Singapore can vary widely based on factors such as location, size, and the amenities offered. It’s advisable to compare different options and consider long-term rentals, as they often provide better value compared to short stays.

Another important aspect to consider is the amenities in the service apartment Singapore, such as housekeeping services, fitness centers, swimming pools, and 24-hour concierge services. These facilities not only enhance comfort but also provide convenience that can make your stay more enjoyable.

The location of your service apartment Singapore is crucial for both work and leisure activities. Ideally, you want an apartment situated close to your workplace to minimize commute times. Additionally, consider proximity to leisure activities such as shopping centers, restaurants, and public transport options. Popular areas for service apartments include the Central Business District (CBD), Orchard Road for shopping enthusiasts, and Marina Bay for those who enjoy scenic views and attractions. A well-located apartment allows you to balance work commitments with leisure activities seamlessly.

Lastly, the experiences of past guests can provide valuable insights into what you can expect from a service apartment Singapore. Reading reviews can guide you in making an informed decision and help avoid potential disappointments.

By carefully considering these factors—price, available facilities, location, and guest experiences—you can select a service apartment Singapore that best fits your needs and ensures a comfortable stay in this vibrant city.

Service apartments Singapore offer an excellent alternative to traditional hotel stays, providing flexibility, comfort, and cost-effectiveness. Whether you’re visiting for business or leisure, these accommodations cater to diverse needs while allowing guests to enjoy a homely atmosphere amidst Singapore’s dynamic environment.

Situated in the heart of the city, our serviced suites in Singapore offer unparalleled convenience. Step out and find yourself just minutes away from Orchard Road’s world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment, making it the perfect base for your urban adventures or daily commute.

Whether you are relocating for business or traveling with family, our serviced suites provide everything you need for a comfortable stay in Singapore. Enjoy access to our top-tier facilities, including a refreshing courtyard pool, a 24-hour gymnasium, and inviting communal spaces designed for both work and relaxation.

FAQ (official)

Frequently Asked Questions - Lanson Place WinslandSkip to contentFrequently Asked Questions

What are the standard check-in and check-out times at Lanson Place Winsland?Check-in: 2:00 PM

What is the smoking policy at Lanson Place Winsland?Smoking is not allowed in apartments or on the property premises.

Is Lanson Place Winsland a pet-friendly serviced apartment?Pets are allowed at our serviced suites. There are additional pet levy charges at SGD30 (inclusive of taxes) per pet per night, or SGD500 (inclusive of taxes) per pet per month.

What are the operating hours of the front desk/concierge at Lanson Place Winsland?Our front desk operates 24 hours a day.

Are baby cots or extra beds available at Lanson Place Winsland?Baby cots are available upon request and are subjected to availability.

Extra roll-away bed are available upon request, subject to availability, and can only be accommodated in certain apartment types. Additional roll-away bed charges apply at SGD70 (inclusive of taxes) per bed per night.

Is there parking available at Lanson Place Winsland?On-site parking is available and chargeable at SGD10 per car per day.

Is there a communal kitchen or self-service laundry at Lanson Place Winsland?Yes, there is a communal kitchen and self-service laundrette at Lanson Place Winsland. The self-service laundrette is equipped with individual washers and dryers, with complimentary usage for all in-house guests. In-room washer cum dryers are also available in Studio Executive Suite, 1 & 2-bedroom apartment units.

How often is housekeeping service provided at Lanson Place Winsland?Housekeeping service is provided three times a week, excluding Sundays & Public Holidays.

Can I request additional housekeeping services during my stay?Additional housekeeping services may be requested for an additional charge.

What payment methods are accepted at Lanson Place Winsland?Visa, MasterCard, UnionPay, and American Express are accepted.

Can I cancel my booking at Lanson Place Winsland? What is the cancellation policy?Once the booking is confirmed, no pre-termination or cancellation is allowed. Please refer to your reservation booking for the applicable Terms & Conditions.

How close is Lanson Place Winsland to the MRT station?The nearest train stations are Somerset MRT Station (3 minutes walk) and Dhoby Ghaut MRT Station (10 minutes walk).

Is Lanson Place Winsland suitable for business travelers?Lanson Place Winsland is well-suited for business travellers. With close proximity to the Central Business District and convenient MRT access, our facilities such as the 24-hour gym, self-service laundrette, fully equipped communal kitchen, and high-speed internet cater to the needs of business travellers, ensuring a productive and comfortable stay.

Can I host gatherings or events at Lanson Place Winsland?Hosting gatherings or events is not permitted at Lanson Place Winsland. Any small gatherings held at our BBQ pits will be subject to the property’s management approval.

Do you have a minimum stay requirement?

Our minimum stay period is 7 days for Wilby Central and 3 months for Wilby Bukit Timah.

Where are your apartments located?

Our properties are situated in 2 prime locations. Wilby Central is located in Bras Basah-Bugis district at 15 Queen Street and Wilby Bukit Timah is located in the upscale neighbourhood of Bukit Timah at 25 Wilby Road.

Are your properties pet-friendly?

(1) Wilby Bukit Timah

We have introduced a new pet policy effective 29 February 2024. Residents may now keep pets—limited to small domesticated dogs (from an approved list) and cats—up to two per apartment. Livestock is strictly prohibited.

Each pet requires a deposit and a monthly fee. All pets must be registered with the management office, providing proof of vaccination, licensing, and NParks AVS approval. Restricted breeds and aggressive or disruptive behavior are not permitted.

Pet owners must keep their animals leashed in common areas, clean up after them, and ensure they do not cause excessive noise or disturbance. Pets may not roam freely or be left unattended. Owners are liable for damages or disturbances caused by their pets, and fines may be imposed.

Guest pets are not allowed without prior management approval. This policy aims to balance a pet-friendly environment with the comfort and safety of all residents. For questions or clarifications, residents are advised to contact the management office.

(2) Wilby Central

For Wilby Central, only certain pets are allowed—please contact the management office for more information.

Do you have a minimum age requirement?

The minimum age for Check-in is 18 years old. Minor must be accompanied by an adult (above 18 years of age). Accompanying adults and minors must be registered during the stay.

Can I book the apartment for someone else?

Yes, you are welcome to book the apartment for someone else if authorized. Please remember to put the correct guest name and input the contact details of the guest.

What time is check-in and check-out?

Our check-in time is 15:00 pm. Check-out is at 12:00 pm.

How do I check-in? Can I check-in anytime?

Upon arrival, please approach our check-in reception or concierge counter. You may check-in anytime at our 24-hour concierge counter in the lobby. Our concierge operates 24 hours daily and will be available to attend to your queries and requests.

Can I request for early check-in or late check-out?

With advance notice, we can arrange for early check-in or late check-out subject to apartment availability. Additional charges may apply. Please note all requests are based on our apartment's availability and are not guaranteed.

Can I extend my stay? How do I request an extension?

Extending your stay is possible (subject to apartment availability). If you need to extend your stay, please email contact@tchospitality.asia with your intended check-out date. Our Sales & Reservations Team will be happy to assist you.

What is your cancellation policy?

Our cancellation policy is determined by the terms of the offer you have selected/booked. Should you require more information, please contact us at contact@tchospitality.asia with your booking confirmation/details.

Can I smoke in the apartment or on my balcony?

Smoking is not permitted in the apartment or within the building premises. Guests who smoke are permitted to do so outside in designated areas. Please reach out to our Concierge or email us at contact@tchospitality.asia for more information.

What is your Child Policy?

Children aged 3 to 6 yrs old stay for free if sharing existing bedding. Guests 7 years and older are considered Adults.
