💡House Rules💡
Inventory Checks

An inventory check will be conducted upon arrival and departure, with the tenant present, to ensure the condition of the room is documented.

No Smoking

Smoking is strictly prohibited within the premises. Any tenant found smoking will be subject to an immediate fine of $200.

Prohibited items

Durian, other consumables known to cause strong odors or permanent stains (e.g., mangosteen, dragon fruit), E-cigarettes, vapes, illicit drugs, explosives, flammable materials, weapons, and hazardous chemicals are strictly forbidden on the property.

Quiet Hours

Please observe quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM to maintain a peaceful environment. Loud music and noise are not allowed during this period.

No Pets

Pets are not allowed under any circumstances.

Room Assignment

Room switching among tenants is strictly prohibited.

Damages & Theft

Tenants are responsible for any damage or loss caused to property during their stay.

Visitors

Visitors are allowed in the room only after registering at the concierge counter.

Stay over guest

Tenants must inform the sales or the front office several days in advance if a stayover guest is expected. Valid identification and SG Arrival card copy will be collected upon guest check-in.

No Parties & Events

No parties or events are permitted in the rooms.

Key Cards

Please keep your room key card secure. Return it upon checkout to avoid a replacement fee of $20plus prevailing GST. Replacement fees are non-refundable, even if the original key is subsequently found.

Room Cleanliness

Tenants are expected to maintain cleanliness in their rooms and shared areas. Food waste must be securely disposed of in the designated chute located in the middle corridor near the exit sign.

Security

Always lock your room when leaving and do not leave valuables or cash unattended.

Check-Out Time

Check-out is by 12:00 PM sharp.

Respect & Conduct

Please treat staff and fellow tenants with courtesy and respect. Proper attire is required at all times.

Gym/Steam room/Sauna/Jacuzzi Rules

Users must adhere to all posted rules and regulations governing these facilities on level 5.

Level 5 Wrightia Lounge

Use of the lounge is on a first-come, first-served basis. Reservations are not accepted. Furniture must remain in place, and all appliances and lights should be turned off when not in use.

Car/Vehicle Parking

Parking is available for a fee.

Lost & Found

Report any lost or found items immediately to the hotel reception.

Emergency Procedures

Familiarize yourself with emergency exits and procedures. The staircase is for emergency use only.

Compliance With Laws

Guests must comply with all applicable laws enforced in Singapore.

Property Damage Liability

Guests are liable for any loss or damage caused by themselves, their visitors, or individuals under their responsibility.

Fire Alarm

In the event of a fire alarm, please follow the evacuation plan posted on the back of your room door.

Sleep Out Notification

Guests planning to sleep outside the premises will need to notify security or concierge.

Wilby App

All tenants are encouraged to download the Wilby App for announcements and updates regarding air conditioning servicing, pest control, and other important information.

Thank you for your cooperation in maintaining a safe and pleasant environment at Wilby Central!

facilities are impeccably clean. We loved the gym, waterfall area, business center, pool and courts!! Every small need was immediately taken care of and we would highly recommend this service apartment to anyone visiting singapore. Short term or long term stay!

Outstanding service, friendly staff, well appointed apartments. My wife is in a wheelchair, and although there are no accessible apartments in the complex, the staff came up with workable solutions to make our stay comfortable. The facilities are first class. The building is centrally located and next to the Great World Mall with an abundance of shops and restaurants. We would be happy to stay here again on our next visit.

I normally don’t stay in serviced apartment but was forced to have a staycation as my flat underwent renovation. I was wowed by a combination of excellent services from the sales team, receptionists, security guards and housekeepers. Upon arrived I was upgraded to a two bedroom apartment which is very clean and well furnished. The pool view I had was really a great touch to my stay. Though housekeeping was done twice a week the job done was excellent. Seriously after numerous stays overseas and here in Singapore this place beats some of the 4/5 stars hotels I stayed. A plus is the mall next door which one can go there under shelter. It offers great eateries and supermarkets. If I ever have to have a staycation this will be my first choice.

We stayed at GWC Service apartment for quite some time and I would highly recommend it.. I would say that the housekeeping team is simply fabulous..better than a 5 star hotel service.. special mention to Huihui, Edwin and also Gowri.. every simple request they paid attention and very considerate and accomodating.. I moved here with a small child and was skeptical...but towards the end of our stay did not want to leave. Thanks a lot to Jesse also during our initial discussion and to her team for seamless execution.

Great option for short-term with a home taste. Much better than hotel.

Each residence, from our cozy 1-Bedroom units to our expansive 4-Bedroom Penthouses, is a complete home. You will find a fully-equipped kitchen with modern appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and dedicated living spaces to work, dine, and relax. Explore our apartment types below to find the perfect fit for your lifestyle.

themed
Created for families who need more than just a place to stay, our themed family apartment brings together space, comfort and playful details that make every day feel like an adventure.

Inspired by Great World Residences’ beloved mascots, Gracie and Spencer, the apartment brings their stories to life through a dedicated children’s hideout designed to spark imagination and discovery. As Great World Residences’ Sustainability Ambassador, Gracie cares deeply about the environment and reminds us that every small green choice can make a difference. Spencer, our Service Excellence Ambassador, loves making friends wherever he goes and represents the welcoming spirit of Great World Residences, where families and pets are equally at home.

The whimsical children’s bedroom features a loft-style bunk bed, Gracie & Spencer-themed décor and activity-friendly touches that encourage young explorers to play, learn and create their own adventures. Complemented by wellness touches from Heveya and the practical comforts of apartment-style living, the experience is thoughtfully curated to help families settle in, explore Singapore and feel right at home.

Discover the carefully selected range of Heveya pillows and beds featured in this hideout — each chosen for their natural, child-friendly materials — at heveya.sg/gracie-spencers-secret-hideout.

The themed children’s bedroom is specially designed with younger children in mind and is best enjoyed by children aged 3 to 10 years old, although families with older children may also appreciate its playful character and comfortable sleeping arrangements.

Our amenities
From our swimming pools and squash courts to our landscaped garden, we have everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Tennis Court — Tennis is great for all elements of fitness and best of all - it's great fun! Invite a friend for a game today.
Swimming & Wading Pools — Whether it’s to squeeze in a few laps after a long day or having some fun in the sun with your little ones, our swimming and wading pools are here for you.
Landscaped Garden — Looking to unwind after a long week? Head down to our beautifully landscaped garden for a short getaway from the bustle of urban living.
On-site Parking — Parking is available for in-house guests at a fee. Please contact the property and provide the car registration number and IU number (for Singaporean vehicles)/Autopass Card number (for Malaysian/foreign vehicles) for registration at least 3 working days prior to check-in date.

Most Popular Facilities: Children’s playground; Complimentary Wi-Fi; Outdoor swimming pool; Parking; Tennis court; Washer/dryer.

Business Facilities: Fax/Photocopying.
Safety and Security: Fire extinguishers; Key card access; Safety deposit box; Smoke alarms.
General: Free local calls.
Wellness: Gym; Sauna.
Official FAQ amenities: Property amenities include free Wi-Fi, gym, swimming pools, jacuzzi, sauna room, tennis and squash court, billiard room and children's playground. Top room amenities include a kitchenette, air conditioning, a LCD TV, and a washer cum dryer.

Dining
Enjoy a plethora of dining delights a few steps away.
Nanbantei Japanese Restaurant — Located right in Far East Plaza, Nanbantei serves up authentic and delectable yakitori skewers in a warm, cozy setting.
Pizza Express — Hailing all the way from the UK, Pizza Express brings freshly made handmade pizzas that come in a variety of unique flavours.
Tiong Bahru Bakery — Best known for its indulgent croissants and kouign amanns with a flaky crust, Tiong Bahru Bakery has an array of pastries, salads and sweet treats to choose from, best paired with coffee.
PS. Cafe — PS. Cafe is the perfect place for a mid-day treat or weekend brunch with friends, offering a slew of mains, salads and their signature desserts guaranteed to satisfy any sweet tooth.
FAQ: There is no on-site food and drink options. The Far East Plaza shopping centre is located right below, which offers a wide variety of dining options.

Official FAQ
What payment methods are accepted by the property? For a seamless transaction, cash and cheque will no longer be accepted at all our hotels and serviced residences in Singapore. Accepted payment methods differ depending on the country, the property and the rates reserved. To find out if your payment method will be accepted by the property, please contact the property directly.
What is the minimum length of stay? A minimum stay of 3 months is required. For more information, please contact or email us at: Far East Plaza Residences— Telephone: +65 6019 0396— Email: info.fepr@fareast.com
Which popular attractions are close to your Serviced Residence? Nearby attractions include Paragon (8-min walk), Ngee Ann City (10-min walk) and ION Orchard (11-min walk).
What are some of the property amenities at your Serviced Residence? Property amenities include free Wi-Fi, gym, swimming pools, jacuzzi, sauna room, tennis and squash court, billiard room and children's playground.
Which room amenities are available at your Serviced Residence? Top room amenities include a kitchenette, air conditioning, a LCD TV, and a washer cum dryer.
What food & drink options are available at your Serviced Residence? There is no on-site food and drink options. The Far East Plaza shopping centre is located right below, which offers a wide variety of dining options.
What is the nearest train station? The nearest train station is Orchard MRT (5-min walk).
What is the check-in and check-out policy of your Serviced Residence? Check-in: 3:00 PM. Checkout: 12:00 PM.
What are the check-in requirements for guests? In accordance with the National Registration Regulations, guests must be at least 18 years of age to check-in. A valid physical identification (passport or NRIC) is required at registration. Driver’s licenses, membership cards, and Singpass will not be accepted.
Are pets allowed? No pets are allowed at Far East Plaza Residences.
Do I need to pay a deposit for the residence during my stay? As the minimum stay at Far East Plaza Residences is three months, a one-month deposit is required. If the stay is more than a year, a two-month deposit is required.
Do you have a washer and dryer? In-room washer and dryer are available at our Serviced Residences. For more information, you may check with our reservation agents or check the Serviced Residences page under room amenities and facilities. For more information, please contact or email us at: Far East Plaza Residences — Telephone: +65 6019 0396 — Email: info.fepr@fareast.com
Do you have parking facilities? On-site parking is available for guests, subject to prevailing parking rates and availability. For more information, please contact or email us at: Far East Plaza Residences— Telephone: +65 6019 0396— Email: info.fepr@fareast.com
Do you have a smoking area at the residence? Smoking is not allowed in our Serviced Residences. There is designated smoking area outside of Far East Plaza shopping centre.
Do you provide airport transfers? Airport transfer to and from our Serviced Residences can be arranged at a charge of SGD 100 per transfer, subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax. *Other standard surcharges apply (subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax), chargeable to the guest. For more information, please contact or email us at: Far East Plaza Residences — Telephone: +65 6019 0396 — Email: info.fepr@fareast.com
Do you provide baby cots or high chairs? Baby cots and high chairs are available and are subjected to availability.
Do you provide laundry services? Laundry services are available daily at a charge, except Sunday and Public Holidays. Dry cleaning and other laundry service are available, you may contact our Management Office for more information.
How many occupants are permitted in each residence? Two-Bedroom Apartment – 4 Adults. Three-Bedroom Apartment – 6 Adults. Three-Bedroom Penthouse – 6 Adults. Four-Bedroom Penthouse – 8 Adults. Children are defined as guests aged 6 years and below. Guest’s request for extra beds during their stay is subject to availability and apartment type. You can make a request 3 days in advance through the Reservations Team OR Front Office Team with a surcharge of SGD 60 per night / SGD 850 per month, subject to prevailing Goods & Services Tax.
Is there a luggage-storing facility? There is no storage of luggage available at our Serviced Residences. However, if it is just few pieces for same day collection, you may check with our Management Office.
What is the housekeeping schedule of the residences? Housekeeping service is provided according to the contractual terms for each apartment on stipulated days and time except on Sundays and Public Holidays. For more information, please contact or email us at: Far East Plaza Residences — Telephone: +65 6019 0396 — Email: info.fepr@fareast.com

RATES AND PAYMENT: The Rates shall be invoiced to the Guest (or to the Guest's Principal, where applicable) at either daily, weekly, monthly or such other intervals determined by the Proprietor. The Rates charged to the Guest shall not be refunded, pro-rated, or used as credits for a future stay, in the event of the premature termination, for any reason, of the Guest's stay.
DEPOSIT: Unless previously agreed in writing between the Proprietor and the Guest's Principal, a Deposit will be collected prior to the commencement of the Guest's stay, which shall be held by the Proprietor throughout the Guest's stay as security. Subject to any deductions, the Deposit or the balance of it shall be repaid to the Guest without interest at any time one (1) month after the end of the Guest's stay. Property FAQ: As the minimum stay at Far East Plaza Residences is three months, a one-month deposit is required. If the stay is more than a year, a two-month deposit is required.
GOODS & SERVICES TAX: The Rates and other sums payable by the Guest under these Terms & Conditions are exclusive of Goods & Services Tax (“GST”).
INTEREST: Interest at the rate of 18% per annum calculated from day to day on the basis of a 365-day year.
UTILITIES AND TELECOMMUNICATION CHARGES: The Guest shall be responsible for all charges (where applicable) relating to the use of telephone line(s) available within the Apartment Unit and water, electricity gas & other utilities supplied to or consumed within the Apartment Unit.
Clause 13 HOUSEKEEPING SERVICES (FOR FAR EAST PLAZA RESIDENCES, VILLAGE RESIDENCE WEST COAST AND ORCHARD SCOTTS RESIDENCES ONLY): Housekeeping and cleaning services will be provided by the Proprietor’s nominated cleaning contractor (the “Housekeeper”) on the following terms; (a) The Housekeeper will provide such housekeeping services at such frequency during the Guest's stay as stipulated by the Proprietor or as may be agreed to between the Guest and the Proprietor, on behalf of the Housekeeper (the “Housekeeping Services”). (b) A fee (the “Housekeeping Fee”) shall be charged to the Guest at such rates applied by the Housekeeper for the extra Housekeeping Services. Property FAQ: Housekeeping service is provided according to the contractual terms for each apartment on stipulated days and time except on Sundays and Public Holidays.
Clause 21.3B — For Residences with Services (Orchard Scotts, Far East Plaza, Village Residence West Coast): If at anytime after the expiration of 3 months from the check-in date, the Guest: (a) shall be transferred out of Singapore permanently by the Guest’s Principal; (b) cease to be employed by the Guest’s Principal; (c) for any cause whatsoever be ordered to leave Singapore permanently by the authorities; or (d) the Guest’s own residential property in Singapore has renovated/ completed and ready for occupation ahead of schedule; then the Guest or Guest’s Principal (where applicable) shall be entitled to terminate the Guest’s stay by giving not less than 1 month notice or paying 1-month Rates in lieu of such notice, with documentary evidence.
House Rules (official): All Invitees are required to register at the Front Office. Entrance doors of the Apartment Unit shall be kept shut. The Guest shall not hang any washing, towel, bedding, clothing or any article on any parts of the Property in such a way as to be visible from the outside of the Property. All washing shall be hung within the Apartment Unit. No ball games are allowed on the Property. Only the Guest and its Permitted Occupants may use the facilities. Invitees may do so when accompanied by the Guest. Eating, drinking and smoking are prohibited in the gymnasium, jacuzzi and swimming pool (where applicable).
Use of the Sauna / Steam Room (Where Applicable): Children under the age of fifteen (15) may not be permitted to use the facilities unless accompanied by an adult.
Use of the Gymnasium: The Guest, its Permitted Occupants and Invitees using the gymnasium and its equipment do so at their own risk. Children under the age of fifteen (15) are not to use the gymnasium and its equipment unless accompanied by adults. Proper attire is required. Wet bathing suits must not be worn in the gymnasium.
Use of the Children’s Playground: For the children’s safety, supervision by adults is required. The Proprietor will not be responsible for any injury.
Use of the Swimming Pool: There are no lifeguards on duty. The Guest or any other person using the pool do so at their own risk. All person must shower before entering the pool. No one who suffers from any infectious diseases shall use the pool. Children under the age of twelve (12) must be accompanied by an adult.
Use of the Tennis / Squash Court (Where Applicable): The Guest must book in advance for the use of the facilities. Bookings can be made at the Guest Service/Management Office on a first-come-first served basis. Children under the age of twelve (12) must be accompanied by an adult.
PET STAY: Unless otherwise permitted by the Proprietor, no pets are allowed in the Apartment Unit. Property FAQ: No pets are allowed at Far East Plaza Residences.

Welcome to Quincy House Singapore
Curated stays inspired by the city, designed around you

Discover Quincy House Singapore, the first Quincy serviced residence, nestled within the dynamic One Holland Village. Offering 255 stylish, pet-friendly units, from Deluxe Rooms to spacious Two-Bedroom apartments, Quincy House delivers an authentic destination living experience, amplified by our signature anticipatory hospitality. With options that include short weekly stays, we cater to a variety of accommodation needs.

Perfectly positioned, Quincy House offers seamless connectivity to the nearby one-north business hubs, making it an ideal choice for professionals seeking both convenience and lifestyle.

Embrace the unique energy of Holland Village, where tradition seamlessly blends with modern living. Be introduced to Holland Village through our Quincy Qurate neighbourhood guide here.

Step outside and immerse yourself in Holland Village's vibrant tapestry of dining, retail, and entertainment, all conveniently at your doorstep. Explore charming indie shops brimming with artisanal treasures and indulge in a diverse culinary scene.

At Quincy House, individuality isn't just welcomed, it's celebrated. Stay you, with a lifestyle curated to your own rhythm.

FAQ
Have a Question? If so you are in the right place.
What payment methods are accepted by the property? For a seamless transaction, cash and cheque will no longer be accepted at all our hotels and serviced residences in Singapore. Accepted payment methods differ depending on the country, the property and the rates reserved. To find out if your payment method will be accepted by the property, please contact the property directly.
What is the check-in and check-out policy of your serviced residence? Check-in: 3:00 PM. Checkout: 12:00 PM.
What are the check-in requirements for guests? In accordance with the National Registration Regulations, guests must be at least 18 years of age to check-in. A valid physical identification (passport or NRIC) is required at registration. Driver’s licenses, membership cards, and Singpass will not be accepted.
Are pets allowed? Pets are allowed in selected apartments at our Serviced Residence, levied at SGD 30 per day or SGD 500 per month, subject to prevailing government taxes.
Do I need to pay a deposit for the residence during my stay? A deposit is generally not required for stays less than three months at our Serviced Residences. If the stay is between three months and one year, we will be collecting a one-month deposit. If the stay is more than one year, we will be collecting a two-month deposit.
Do you have a washer and dryer? In-room washer and dryer are available in selected apartments. A self-launderette is also available for your usage located on Level 1. For more information, you may check with our reservation agents or check the Serviced Residences page under room amenities and facilities. For more information, you may contact us at: Quincy House Singapore — Email: sales.sr@fareast.com
Do you provide laundry services? Laundry services are available daily at a charge, except on Sunday and Public Holidays. Dry-cleaning and other laundry services are available, you may check with our front desk for more information.
Do you provide airport transfers? Airport transfer to and from our serviced residences can be arranged at a charge of SGD 100 per transfer, subject to prevailing government taxes. *Other standard surcharges apply (subject to prevailing government taxes), chargeable to the guest. For more information, you may contact us at: Quincy House Singapore — Email: sales.sr@fareast.com
Do you have parking facilities? On-site parking is available for guests, subject to prevailing parking rates and availability. For more information, you may contact us at: Quincy House Singapore — Email: sales.sr@fareast.com
Do you have smoking or non-smoking residences? Quincy House Singapore is a non-smoking residence.
Do you provide baby cots or high chairs? Baby cots and high chairs are available and are subject to availability.
How many occupants are permitted in each residence? Deluxe Room – 2 Adults. One-Bedroom Deluxe – 2 Adults. Two-Bedroom Superior – 2 Adults. Two-Bedroom Deluxe – 4 Adults. Children are defined as guests aged 6 years and below. Guest’s request for extra beds during their stay is subject to availability and apartment type. You can make a request 3 days in advance through the Reservations Teams or Front Office Team with a surcharge of SGD 60 per night/ SGD 850 per month, subject to prevailing government taxes.
Is there luggage-storing facility? Storage of luggage is unavailable at our Serviced Residences.
What is the housekeeping schedule of the residences? Daily Housekeeping (except Sunday and Public Holidays).
What is the nearest train station? The nearest train station is Holland Village MRT (3-min walk).

Staying longer than a month? We’re happy to extend our best rate for you. Just leave your contact and trip details with us and we’ll get back to you soon!
